e4a960f781aeb3023a406e4990b741212d0cafce.title: Freebuff CLI release 0.1.0 with partner ad slots and house ad fixes
e4a960f781aeb3023a406e4990b741212d0cafce.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.1.0 adds two partner ad placements (`CLI-Partner-Composer-PR` and `CLI-Partner-Slash-Review`) rendered as single branded rows in the terminal, alongside a refactor of the ad auction request builder in `cli/src/ads/ad-request.ts` and house ad copy corrections in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts` that clarify tier naming and daily session totals. The release also raises `DEFAULT_BACKEND_XMIN_XID` in `common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts` from 1M to 10M transactions to prevent false pages from scheduled day-grain scans, since the fleet now commits approximately 5,300 transactions per second. Six other changes were included in this release but their details are not available; the version manifest bump to 0.1.0 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` marks the first release in the 0.1.x line.
e4a960f781aeb3023a406e4990b741212d0cafce.evidence: The diff bumps `DEFAULT_BACKEND_XMIN_XID` from 1_000_000 to 10_000_000 in `common/src/util/db-health-alerts.ts` and updates the version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.204 to 0.1.0. The release includes partner ad slots in `cli/src/ads/partner-ads.ts` and house ad copy updates in `common/src/constants/freebuff-house-ad.ts`.

Corrected house ad copy to use actual tier names and clarify daily session totals vs free pool
Raised DEFAULT_BACKEND_XMIN_XID from 1M to 10M to reduce false pages from scheduled database scans
Bumped Freebuff CLI version from 0.0.204 to 0.1.0
Added chat-ready boot signal and multi-pattern wait helper to e2e test utilities

afe1bfdf35f46fa3a26160855494e968ed5420c7.text: Freebuff 0.1.9 adds GPT-6.1 Sol to the free model picker as a temporary promotional offer, available for free in the US and requiring a paid plan elsewhere, with a cap of one session per day for every account. A new badge in the model pickers flags GPT-6.1 Sol and Muse Spark 1.3 as newly added, with tooltips explaining their context size and availability. The CLI now tracks when you click an ad and whether you type your next prompt immediately, using that timing to measure ad engagement. Links in sponsored tasks are automatically tagged so advertisers can see which clicks came from Freebuff, without altering any link that already has its own tracking labels.

f8c7a1ad8f21d84791d5bfd94277c937aa6d9f3f.text: Freebuff CLI 0.1.10 adds a new control for people using their own AI account keys, letting them choose how much effort the AI puts into thinking before answering. You can set this thinking level to low, medium, or high, or leave it on default so the provider decides. If the provider does not understand the setting, the tool automatically retries the request without it so your task continues instead of failing. The release also adds internal tracking for paid subscription details, including how to calculate monthly revenue from yearly plans and how to count subscribers by their billing schedule. These internal measures help the service operators understand their paid customer base and costs, but they do not change the free tier or the model options available to you. One other change in the release could not be verified because its summary was discredited, so its specific effect is unknown.

38cd1ed44428f573c4754d8e0cee868f2875b54e.text: Freebuff version 0.0.204 prevents your paid session from expiring when the app is closed by an outside force instead of you quitting normally. If your terminal window closes, the computer shuts down, or the app is otherwise interrupted by the system, your active time is now saved so you can pick up right where you left off on your next launch without paying again. The app also no longer abruptly shuts down and loses your work if the internal display engine freezes or encounters a severe glitch. When the tool does crash, it now saves a small report locally and automatically sends it to the developers the next time you open it, replacing the old method that required users to take screenshots of errors. Finally, a specific signal that could accidentally terminate the app when background processes were disconnected has been explicitly ignored, keeping the interface stable.

f93daaf339a2cd84e01d8695bd8e091a6d2dc0ad.text: The newest partner ad slot in the terminal now appears when you are preparing to launch your project. You will see a single line of advertising above the input box when you type words like deploy, ship, or announce, alongside the existing ads that appear when you discuss pull requests. If you maintain a long streak of daily use, the Freebucks you earn are now added to your daily allowance instead of your permanent wallet, and the app now clearly shows you exactly when that bonus expires. The one-time announcement about a recent model tier change has been removed from the main menu to keep the screen less cluttered.

e4a960f781aeb3023a406e4990b741212d0cafce.text: Freebuff CLI 0.1.0 introduces two new partner ad slots for terminal users: a single colored line above the text input when you are working on pull requests, and a matching line under the /review command in the slash menu. These partner ads always display the word "Ad" for transparency, use the advertiser's specific colors when your terminal supports them, and disappear completely if the ad cannot be loaded. The text for the Freebuff subscription promotion has been corrected to name the Starter plan and clearly state that you get more hours per day, rather than mislabeling it as Pro or omitting the time unit. Additionally, the internal database monitoring alarm for stuck data operations has had its threshold increased to match the current transaction rate, which stops the system from sending unnecessary alerts during normal scheduled maintenance.

dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.title: Release 0.0.202 ships out-of-credits 402 exclusion
dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.0.202 publishes an error handling correction in `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts`. The `isFreebuffProviderUsageError` function now checks the error message against `CODEBUFF_OWN_CREDITS_ERROR_PATTERN` and returns false before testing provider-specific status codes, preventing a user's own Codebuff balance exhaustion from being mislabeled as a free provider usage failure. The new pattern constant tests for `codebuff.com/usage` in `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts`, which routes the 402 response to the standard out-of-credits flow instead of the free-tier billing message.
dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.evidence: The diff shows the version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumping from `0.0.201` to `0.0.202`. The release evidence cites commit `06bf5c33` where `isFreebuffProviderUsageError` in `cli/src/utils/error-handling.ts` now early-returns `false` if the message matches the new `CODEBUFF_OWN_CREDITS_ERROR_PATTERN` imported from `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts`.
dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.unknowns: The release notes mention one additional change was excluded from the list due to a failed check, but its source evidence is not provided.

a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.203 elides binary payloads in compaction
a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.summary: Release 0.0.203 introduces binary payload elision in the agent runtime to prevent base64 data from inflating context token counts during compaction. The new function elideBinaryStrings in packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts replaces media parts and long base64 runs with a placeholder string when serializing history for the summarizer. This prevents screenshot-heavy threads from triggering massive sequential summarizer calls that previously stalled the agent loop.
a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.evidence: The primary diff shows a version bump in freebuff/cli/release/package.json from 0.0.202 to 0.0.203. The release member source evidence cites changes in packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts where a new elideBinaryStrings function is added to replace base64 data URLs with placeholders during history serialization.

a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.text: This release fixes a problem where saving large images or files in your coding history caused the AI assistant to stop responding. Previously, huge data strings from screenshots or embedded files were copied into the summary process, which could consume millions of units of processing space and cause long waits or complete failures. Now, the assistant labels these large data blocks instead of copying them, ensuring the summary process stays manageable and threads do not freeze. Additionally, the assistant now correctly remembers your conversation when you edit or undo previous steps. Previously, if you stopped and restarted a task multiple times, editing an earlier message could cause the assistant to forget most of the conversation because it miscounted what constituted a new user turn. The fix ensures that only your actual prompts are counted for memory, so your context remains intact even in long or frequently paused sessions.

dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.text: This release corrects a billing error for users who run out of credits on their paid account. Previously, the system sometimes confused a paid account running dry with a free-tier service issue, potentially showing the wrong message or blocking access incorrectly. The update ensures that when your personal credit balance is empty, you see the standard 'out of credits' notice instead of a misleading message about the free service needing a refill. This change applies specifically to users on paid plans who attempt to use models that require balance.

f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.201 with legacy hour resume and partner ad slots
f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.0.201 packages two functional changes. The session hook `use-freebuff-session.ts` now probes for a legacy single-session hour left by a dead pre-multi-session CLI process via `deadLegacyFreebuffOwner`, resuming it without a new purchase on update restarts. The placement model in `freebuff-placements.ts` adds the `partner` format and two new slots (`Desktop-Partner-Skill-Picker`, `Desktop-Partner-Composer-PR`) that are exclusive to a single advertiser and excluded from self-serve targeting.
f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.evidence: The diff in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumps the `version` from `0.0.200` to `0.0.201`. The release notes cite member commits `a78f5290` and `9e3fdf76`, whose source hunks show `deadLegacyFreebuffOwner` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-instance-owner.ts` and `partner` slots in `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts`.

9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.title: Solar Pro 4 returns to free model picker and CLI crash recovery
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.summary: Solar Pro 4 re-enters the free model picker at 10 Freebucks under the `SOLAR_PRO_4_OFFER` tagline, replacing its previously retired status with a 2026-09-25 entry in the Solar price history, and its limited access entitlement is added to `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS` so it appears in the restricted catalog. In parallel, the CLI can now resume an hour bought by a crashed session via `consumeCrashedFreebuffSession`, which reads per-PID records, validates that the owner process is dead, and claims the hour atomically. Ad requests from the CLI now include an `adTraceContext` carrying trace session and run IDs, allowing the server to link a served ad to the specific agent prompt that prompted it, with pointer advancement for interrupted runs handled by `noteFinishedRunForAdTrace`.
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.evidence: The release window modifies `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` to bump the version to 0.0.199. Source members include the addition of Solar Pro 4 to the free model picker in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` (using the new `SOLAR_PRO_4_OFFER` at 10 Freebucks), the introduction of crash recovery logic in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-relaunch.ts` via `consumeCrashedFreebuffSession`, and the implementation of the `adTraceContext` field in `cli/src/state/chat-store.ts` to track trace session and run IDs for ad requests in `cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts` and `cli/src/utils/sponsored-offer.ts`.
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.unknowns: The diff does not show the internal server-side implementation of how the trace context pointer is resolved or the specific conditions under which the limited access entitlement is granted.

baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.200 release
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.summary: Freebuff CLI version 0.0.200 is published, bundling several functional changes since 0.0.199. On local Linux terminals, a successful OSC 52 clipboard copy that cannot be verified appends LINUX_OSC52_ONLY_HINT to the toast and extends its display duration to 6000 ms to warn that paste may be empty without wl-clipboard or xclip. Sponsored local execution now refuses shell commands entering WSL, performing destructive database operations, or managing containers, and allows campaigns to declare up to two account credentials via a requires-credential: line that is injected into the sandboxed run environment and redacted from model-visible output.
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.evidence: The commit baffcb89 bumps the version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json from 0.0.199 to 0.0.200. Release member evidence includes cli/src/utils/clipboard.ts adding LINUX_OSC52_ONLY_HINT, common/src/ads/sponsored-run-credentials.ts implementing strict credential parsing for sponsored runs, and common/src/ads/sponsored-command-refusals.ts blocking WSL, destructive database, and container commands.
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.unknowns: The release notes state that 8 additional changes were excluded from the summary list because a check discredited their prose, so their specific behaviors are not described here.

5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.197: Deferred updates, read-only chat, multi-session
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.summary: This release bundles three major CLI changes into version 0.0.197. The launcher now supports deferred self-updates for Freebuff, where downloaded binaries stage to a per-process temp directory and only install when the running session exits, preventing binary replacement during an active session. A new `ReadOnlyChat` component renders saved transcripts without a composer or run callbacks, reachable via the `H` shortcut, and the session API now issues private per-process claim IDs prefixed with `cli:` to support multi-session polling.
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.evidence: The commit modifies `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` to bump the version from `0.0.196` to `0.0.197`. The release notes include source evidence for `cli/src/utils/freebucks.ts`, `cli/release-core/launcher.js`, `cli/src/app.tsx`, and `cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-identity.ts`.
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.unknowns: The release notes state that 5 other changes were omitted because a check discredited their summary, so the full scope of the 0.0.196 to 0.0.197 window is not fully described.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.198 switches sponsored runs to in-place execution
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.summary: Freebuff CLI version `0.0.198` replaces the sponsored proposal worktree flow with an in-place execution model so accepted tasks edit the user's working copy directly instead of creating a separate branch. The release includes the in-place execution contract from commit `aeff04d6`, which removes `handleProposalPullRequest` and `handleProposalRemoveWorktree` commands in favor of `handleProposalUndo` in `cli/src/commands/ads.ts`. The new `sponsored-git.ts` module replaces the previous `sponsored-worktree` dependency for git operations, and `project-files.ts` now writes `.freebuff/project-id` markers in every Git repository when `IS_FREEBUFF` is true.
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.evidence: The diff bumps `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` version from `0.0.197` to `0.0.198`. The release notes cite member `aeff04d6` which removes the `sponsored-worktree` import in `cli/src/utils/sponsored-cli-capability.ts` and adds `cli/src/utils/sponsored-git.ts`, grounding the shift to in-place execution.

f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.text: The CLI now preserves the remaining time from a previous session when you update the app, so you do not lose the time you already paid for. It also adds new ad slots that display an advertiser's own branding directly next to the skill picker or composer instead of showing a generic ad card. These new slots are exclusive to specific ad deals and cannot be targeted by regular advertisers in the console. If your previous session has ended or belongs to a different account, the new version safely falls back to starting a fresh session rather than trying to reuse the old one.

baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.text: Freebuff CLI 0.0.200 adds stricter safety guards for advertiser-funded tasks and improves how the terminal handles copying on Linux. For sponsored runs, the system now blocks commands that could enter your Windows subsystem, wipe databases, or start and stop containers, ensuring these automated tasks cannot interfere with your personal work or running services. If a sponsored task needs an account credential, the system asks you for it in a hidden field and automatically hides that secret from the AI's view in all output and error messages. In addition, the CLI now shows a helpful hint when you copy text on a Linux terminal without standard clipboard tools installed, telling you exactly which software to add to make pasting work. The release also tightens privacy wording to clarify that advertising partners can only evaluate connected cloud repositories and cannot train on your code.

9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.text: The free model picker now includes Solar Pro 4, a larger and stronger text-only model from Upstage with a 524K context window. This model is available in both full and limited access tiers, and it costs 10 Freebucks per session. Users are no longer forced to switch from Solar Pro 4 to Solar Mini 4 if they had it saved as their preference, since the replacement warning is gone. If your coding session crashes or your terminal closes unexpectedly, the next time you open the tool, it checks for a saved session and resumes your remaining time instead of starting a new paid session. Advertising requests now include two reference IDs that link the ad to your specific conversation and the last completed task, but no actual text from your code or prompts is sent.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.text: This release changes how sponsored tasks run in the Freebuff terminal: instead of creating a separate, temporary copy of your project to work in, the task now edits the files directly in the folder you have open. When you approve a sponsored task, it streams its progress into your normal conversation history, and any messages you type will wait until the task finishes before being sent. To undo a sponsored task, you now use a single "ads:undo" command instead of the previous commands for creating pull requests or removing temporary folders; this new undo function restores your files to how they were before the task ran. The terminal now identifies your specific project folder by a unique local ID, which allows it to offer sponsored tasks to projects that do not have a connected remote code repository. Additionally, a new keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+O) now opens the details of a sponsored task when it is active, replacing the previous shortcut's function for display ads.

a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.title: /reasoning slash command opens model effort picker
a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.summary: The Freebuff CLI adds the /reasoning command (aliases /effort and /think), which opens the reasoning effort submenu for the currently selected model without committing to a new session. The command is registered in the Freebuff-only set in `command-registry.ts` and `slash-commands.ts`, so it is excluded from Codebuff builds. The `freebuff-model-selector.tsx` component gains an `initialView` prop that initializes the reasoning submenu to the saved effort level for the target model, defaulting to the directory's preferred effort when no save exists. Selecting an effort persists it via `setReasoningEffort` and returns to the model list, while pressing Escape cancels without changing the model selection or triggering session admission.
a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.evidence: cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts adds a 'reasoning' command with aliases 'effort' and 'think', while cli/src/state/freebuff-chat-store.ts exports openFreebuffReasoningPicker and cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx gains an initialView prop to render the reasoning submenu on open.

6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.196 release with session preservation and content
6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.summary: Freebuff CLI version 0.0.196 preserves held session slots when the launcher restarts the binary for an update, adding `keepSlotForRelaunch` to `cli/src/state/freebuff-session-store.ts` and `isLauncherUpdateTermination` to `cli/src/utils/launcher-update-restart.ts` so users do not lose paid hours. The release also adds a DeepSeek content filter error pattern and message to `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts`, instructing users to switch models when the provider's filter rejects a request.
6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.evidence: The diff bumps the version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.0.195 to 0.0.196. The release member source evidence shows `cli/src/utils/launcher-update-restart.ts` adding `isLauncherUpdateTermination` and `cli/src/state/freebuff-session-store.ts` adding `keepSlotForRelaunch` to preserve session slots during launcher updates, while `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts` introduces `FREEBUFF_PROVIDER_CONTENT_FILTER_ERROR_PATTERN`.

6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.text: Freebuff CLI 0.0.196 adds session preservation for automatic updates, a new security layer for in-place sponsored tasks, and the GPT-6 Luna model for the Chat thinker. If the CLI updates itself while you have a free session running, it now keeps that session active instead of ending it, so the relaunched app resumes where you left off without losing your purchase. A new "delivered" state and strict safety rules apply to sponsored tasks that edit your project files directly; these runs are blocked from changing your version control history or reading secret files, and you can review or undo their changes right in your files. The Chat thinker agent now uses the GPT-6 Luna model, while the previous GPT-5.6 Luna version is withdrawn from the free picker. The most immediate impact for you is that auto-updates no longer interrupt or drop your active free sessions, and you get a clear, reversible way to handle advertiser-funded code changes that happen inside your current folder.

a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.text: The free coding assistant now includes a dedicated shortcut to adjust how much time a chosen AI model spends thinking before answering a question. Only people using the free version of the tool in their terminal will see this option; the paid version does not get it. When you use the new shortcut, you can pick a reasoning level for your current model and save that preference, or simply back out without changing anything, letting you fine-tune how deeply the assistant works on each task.

a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.title: Add /todo command for live agent checklist panel
a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.summary: The CLI introduces a new `/todo` slash command (alias `/todos`) that opens a local, read-only panel displaying the main agent's current task checklist outside the main transcript. The panel, implemented in `cli/src/components/todo-panel.tsx`, uses `getLatestTodos` from `cli/src/utils/todos.ts` to extract the most recent valid `write_todos` tool block from root-level AI messages, ignoring subagent checklists and malformed inputs. When open, the panel takes over the composer area and disables the global chat keyboard listener, closing automatically when another priority panel (such as a review screen or sponsored proposal menu) takes over the UI.
a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.evidence: New files `cli/src/components/todo-panel.tsx` and `cli/src/utils/todos.ts` introduce `TodoPanel` and `getLatestTodos`, which are wired into `cli/src/chat.tsx` via the `todoPanelOpen` state and rendered in place of the composer. `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` and `cli/src/data/slash-commands.ts` register the new `/todo` command (alias `/todos`) which returns `{ openTodoPanel: true }` to trigger this UI state.

547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.title: Add /model command and inline chat admission for Freebuff sessions
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.summary: The Freebuff CLI now supports changing the AI model and session state from within an active chat. A new /model slash command opens an inline model picker, and a new chat admission flow holds queued messages and requests wallet consent when the user submits a prompt that requires a new or different session. Several other related changes accompany this feature in the same commit. These include a redesign of the help banner into a scrollable three-column layout, the addition of a ? shortcut to open help and a Left arrow shortcut to open chat history when the input is empty, and the removal of the /reasoning command.
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.evidence: New files cli/src/state/freebuff-chat-store.ts (defining useFreebuffChatStore, openFreebuffModelPicker, and requestFreebuffChatAdmission) and cli/src/components/freebuff-chat-controls.tsx (rendering the in-chat model selector and consent prompt) are introduced, while cli/src/commands/reasoning.ts is deleted and cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts replaces the /reasoning command with a new /model command that calls openFreebuffModelPicker().
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.unknowns: The diff does not state why the /reasoning command was removed instead of being integrated into /model. A second read of the same diff did not confirm that a migration step is required.

changes.what: Adds a /model command to open the model picker and removes the /reasoning command and its aliases.
Introduces inline chat admission and model switching controls that hold the message queue and prompt for spending consent.
Redesigns the help banner into a responsive multi-column layout and adds ? and Left arrow keyboard shortcuts for help and history.
Adds a persistent Freebuff-specific header and footer showing model, reasoning effort, and chat name above and below the main chat area.
Extracts the Freebuff ASCII wordmark into a dedicated utility module to be used by the login screen and chat header.

a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.text: The Freebuff CLI now includes a new command that lets you open a live, read-only window showing the main AI assistant's current task checklist. This panel appears where the text input usually is, so you can watch the progress of a long task without scrolling back through the conversation. It updates in real time as the assistant checks off items, and it closes automatically if you start a different panel, like a review screen. If you open the checklist before the assistant creates any tasks, the panel stays open and waits for the first item to appear.

547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.text: Freebuff users can now type /model in the middle of a chat to choose a different AI model or set how deeply it thinks, and a bottom status bar shows the current model and how to change it. When you type a new prompt while the assistant is waiting for a session to start, your message stays saved in the input box and the app asks for your approval to spend credits before sending it. This also means the old /reasoning command no longer exists, the ? key opens a new three-column shortcut guide, and the Left arrow key opens your chat history when the input box is empty. The button on the earnings screen for metered accounts now says Learn More instead of Open Earn.

0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.title: MiMo free agents use current model display name in prompts
0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.summary: The `base2-free-mimo` and `base3-free-mimo` agent definitions now pass a `modelLabel` option to their respective creation functions. This label is resolved via `getFreebuffModel(FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID).displayName`, which returns the current human-readable name "MiMo 2.6 Flash". This ensures the agent prompts refer to the accurate model name instead of the legacy 2.5 wire id, while the underlying model configuration remains unchanged.
0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.evidence: In `agents/base2/base2.ts`, a new `modelLabel` option was added to `createBase2` and `agents/base2/base2-free-mimo.ts` passes `getFreebuffModel(FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID).displayName` to it. Similarly, `agents/base3-free-mimo.ts` passes the same value to `createBase3CliRoot`.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.title: Bump Freebuff CLI to 0.0.198 with in-place sponsored undo
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.summary: The Freebuff CLI version is incremented to 0.0.198, packaging the transition of sponsored agent runs from a git worktree flow to an in-place execution model. The `/ads:pull-request` and `/ads:remove-worktree` commands are removed from the command registry and replaced by a new `/ads:undo` command that reverse-applies file edit receipts directly to the working copy without creating commits or branches. This change ensures that interrupted or completed in-place runs can be cleanly reverted using the receipts stored on disk, rather than deleting a detached worktree.
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.evidence: The diff in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumps the version from `0.0.197` to `0.0.198`. The release member evidence in `cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts` shows the removal of `handleProposalPullRequest` and `handleProposalRemoveWorktree` handlers and the addition of `handleProposalUndo`, while `cli/src/commands/ads.ts` replaces the worktree-based handlers with a new in-place undo implementation that reverse-applies edit receipts.

38d5cf2d883a9700d1618b9f7d87d7b18500c1b2.title: Provider errors now trigger in-band stream recovery
38d5cf2d883a9700d1618b9f7d87d7b18500c1b2.summary: The agent runtime now treats in-band provider failures (5xx/429) as auto-recoverable stream endings instead of fatal errors, matching the behavior already used for severed connections. A new `classifyProviderErrorRecovery` function inspects AI SDK error chunks for retryable statuses or server-side upstream error tags, and the stream loop in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` pauses for a bounded backoff (up to 10,000 ms) before yielding the recovery note. The `packages/agent-runtime` stream parser appends a `PROVIDER_ERROR` tag to the conversation and, after three consecutive recoveries, surfaces the last provider error detail in the final error so support can diagnose the specific HTTP status.
38d5cf2d883a9700d1618b9f7d87d7b18500c1b2.evidence: The diff adds `classifyProviderErrorRecovery` to `sdk/src/impl/stream-interruption.ts` and a `provider-error` variant to `StreamRecoverySource` in `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts`, with new constants like `PROVIDER_ERROR_MAX_RETRY_DELAY_MS` and `PROVIDER_ERROR_TAG` in `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/stream-parser.ts`.

Extends the stream parser to handle the new provider-error recovery tag and include error details in the give-up message.

5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.197: deferred updates and read-only chat
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.0.197 ships deferred self-updates for the launcher wrapper, routing active Freebuff sessions to the Desktop purchase store for price quotes, adding a read-only transcript viewer, and introducing multi-session claim identity. The Freebuff launcher now opts into deferred self-updates via the `deferUpdatesUntilExit: true` config, staging downloaded updates to a per-process temp directory and installing them only when the running session exits. Active CLI sessions with a `cli:`-prefixed instance id now use the `desktop` store surface for Freebucks pricing instead of the legacy `single` store.
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.evidence: The release commit bumps the version in freebuff/cli/release/package.json from 0.0.196 to 0.0.197. The release notes identify four source changes included in this window: Freebucks price routing, deferred launcher updates, read-only chat browsing, and multi-session claim identity.

The snapshot also deletes several sponsored ad and Supabase format experiment modules, including `common/src/ads/sponsored-proposal-conformance.ts`, `common/src/ads/sponsored-verification.ts`, and `common/src/ads/supabase-format-experiment.ts`. These removals clean up internal conformance matrices and experimental billing logic that are no longer active. The version manifest in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` is bumped from 0.2.7 to 0.2.8.

0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.text: The instructions given to the free-tier assistant now refer to the current, human-friendly name of the MiMo model instead of an older internal code. This is an internal adjustment to the agent definitions that ensures the assistant identifies itself with the accurate model name. You will not see any change in available features or model lists; the assistant simply uses the correct name in its prompts.

38d5cf2d883a9700d1618b9f7d87d7b18500c1b2.text: When the AI coding assistant encounters a temporary service failure or temporary limit from the model provider while streaming a response, it now automatically pauses briefly and retries the connection instead of ending the session with an error. This improvement helps developers using the CLI, web app, or desktop app by reducing unexpected interruptions during coding tasks. If the problem persists, the assistant will clearly report the specific provider error to help you understand why the retry failed.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.text: This release changes how the free coding assistant handles sponsored tasks so they run directly inside your active chat instead of in a separate, isolated area. When you accept a sponsored task, the AI now makes changes to the files in your current project folder, and you can use a new undo command to reverse those changes if you decide to keep or discard them. The system now identifies each project folder with a unique internal ID, ensuring that sponsored offers and their results are correctly matched to the specific folder you are working in. A new warning is shown during the approval step to clearly tell you that the task will edit your files immediately, replacing the previous information about creating a separate branch. The assistant also now pauses your own queued messages while a sponsored task is running, ensuring that your next message waits until the sponsored task is finished.

5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.text: When Freebuff updates itself, it now waits until you close the program before installing the new version, so your current session is not interrupted. If a previous chat is still open but no longer has access to an AI model, you can now read the old conversation without typing new messages; this read-only view also hides feedback buttons for past answers. You can press the H key on several screens to browse your chat history, including the screen that appears when a session has ended. The app now uses a specific identifier for your computer's sessions, which helps it manage multiple active sessions correctly and ensures your purchased time is not lost when the app updates itself.

3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.title: OpenTUI renderer fallback to config dir and temp cleanup on startup
3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.summary: The CLI now loads the OpenTUI native renderer up front via `ensureRenderLibrary`, falling back to a content-addressed copy in the CLI config directory when the temp-directory extraction by Bun fails due to space, permissions, or noexec restrictions. After a successful start, `sweepLeakedRenderLibraryCopies` removes stale byte-identical copies that Bun leaves behind in the temp directory. The `BUN_TMPDIR` environment variable is read to locate Bun's extraction directory for both the fallback logic and the cleanup sweep.
3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.evidence: New file `cli/src/utils/opentui-native-library.ts` introduces `ensureRenderLibrary` and `sweepLeakedRenderLibraryCopies`; `cli/src/index.tsx` now calls these to load the OpenTUI renderer with a config-directory fallback and clean up stale temp copies on startup.

b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.title: Terminal broker temp-file diagnostics and empty-result handling
b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.summary: The CLI terminal command broker now probes the temp directory after a lost result to distinguish a full or read-only disk from other failures, providing specific recovery guidance instead of a generic restart message. `writeProtocolResponse` now removes the partial file and writes a diagnostic to stderr when the write fails, preventing the parent from interpreting an empty file as a JSON parse error. `parseProtocol` was updated to treat empty or truncated input as a specific incomplete-response error rather than surfacing raw `JSON.parse` exceptions.
b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.evidence: The diff in `cli/src/utils/terminal-command-broker.ts` introduces `probeTempDirectory` and refactors `writeProtocolResponse` to remove partial files on failure; it also updates `parseProtocol` to throw `INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE_MESSAGE` instead of raw JSON errors, and wires `probeTempDirectory` into `createTerminalCommandBroker`'s error handling.

f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.title: SDK stops retrying final session and spend refusals
f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.summary: The SDK model provider now treats intentional server refusals, specifically the per-turn spend breaker and superseded session errors, as final by throwing a non-retryable `APICallError` on the first response. The previous logic only handled the 429 spend limit, but now a new `FINAL_REFUSALS` table checks the response status and error code to bypass the AI SDK's default retry loop for these specific failures. This change ensures that the user-facing error message from the server is preserved and not masked by generic rate-limit or conflict retry noise.
f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.evidence: In `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts`, the `throwIfTurnSpendCapped` function was replaced by `throwIfFinalRefusal` and a new `FINAL_REFUSALS` array that includes both the `turn_spend_limit` 429 and the `session_superseded` 409; `sdk/src/impl/stream-interruption.ts` updated its comment to reference `FINAL_REFUSALS`.

5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.text: Freebuff CLI 0.2.16 enables fast mode, which allows you to use a specific high-speed DeepSeek model in the free tier, and hardens the terminal renderer to handle startup failures better. If your temporary storage is full or blocked, the CLI now copies its necessary components to a safe location and tells you exactly how to fix the issue instead of crashing silently. It also cleans up leftover files from previous launches to prevent your temporary storage from filling up over time. When the assistant tries to run terminal commands, it now gives clear instructions if the system cannot record the result due to storage issues, telling you to free up space or change where temporary files are saved. Additionally, the release stops the app from endlessly retrying specific server refusals, such as when a session has ended or your spending limit is reached, so you get a clear message immediately instead of waiting for repeated failures.

3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.text: The Freebuff CLI now checks for the terminal drawing engine before opening your chat window, and if the temporary storage space on your computer is full, locked, or blocked from running programs, it automatically uses a saved backup copy stored in the app’s own settings folder instead of failing. After the app starts successfully, it quietly deletes old, duplicate copies of this drawing engine left behind by previous launches to free up space. You will not notice anything unless you had a full or restricted temporary drive; in that specific case, the app will now open normally or show a clear message explaining how to fix the storage issue rather than crashing with an unreadable error.

b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.text: When the assistant runs a command in your terminal, it now saves the result in a temporary file on your computer instead of sending it through a pipe. If that file fails to save because your storage is full, the assistant will tell you exactly what is wrong and how to fix it, instead of showing a confusing error code. You will notice this when a command fails due to a full disk; the message will explain the issue and note that restarting the assistant will not help until you free up space.

0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.text: The free assistant now correctly labels the MiMo model it uses in the background instead of showing an outdated internal code. This is an internal maintenance change that keeps the internal instructions for the assistant consistent with the current model names, with no visible effect on your daily use or any action needed on your part.

f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.text: When the service deliberately refuses a request because you hit a spending cap or because your session was already started elsewhere, the software now stops immediately instead of quietly waiting and trying again up to four times. This applies to anyone using the free coding assistant in their terminal, on the web, or on their desktop. You will no longer see a misleading "rate limit" delay; instead, the assistant will show the specific reason for the refusal right away and let you start fresh.

38d5cf2d883a9700d1618b9f7d87d7b18500c1b2.text: The coding assistant can now pause briefly and try again when a model service fails mid-response, instead of stopping the entire task instantly. This affects you when using the Freebuff CLI, web, or desktop apps, making the assistant more resilient during temporary outages or rate limits. In daily use, you are less likely to see a session cut short by a server error; if the issue persists after three attempts, the assistant will explain that the model provider is struggling and suggest trying again later.

5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.16: fast mode served and renderer fallback
5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.summary: The release flips `FREEBUFF_SERVE_FAST_MODE` to true in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, making the DeepSeek Flash fast mode row visible in the server catalog, Freebucks pricing, and Web picker, which the release notes state took effect on 2026-10-05. The CLI now loads the OpenTUI native renderer up front via `ensureRenderLibrary`, falling back to a content-addressed copy in the config directory when the temp directory is full, read-only, or noexec, and sweeping stale extractions from the temp directory on each start. The terminal command broker probes the temp directory after a lost result to distinguish disk-space or permission failures from other errors, and the SDK treats `session_superseded` 409 responses as non-retryable alongside the existing `turn_spend_limit` 429 refusal.
5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.evidence: The commit 5d02de3e changes the version field in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from 0.2.15 to 0.2.16. The release notes and member source evidence show that this version bump includes the enabling of the `FREEBUFF_SERVE_FAST_MODE` server switch, the addition of a native renderer library fallback and temp-directory cleanup in `cli/src/index.tsx`, improved terminal command broker diagnostics for temp directory failures, a `modelLabel` option for MiMo agents to display the correct model name, and the SDK now treating `session_superseded` 409 errors as final refusals that stop the AI SDK's 4-attempt retry loop.

7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.title: Space Bunny Alpha loses recommended badge in picker
7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.summary: Space Bunny Alpha no longer carries the recommended badge in the free model picker. The PLACEMENTS map in `common/src/util/freebuff-picker-sections.ts` dropped the recommended: true flag for the `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` entry, reflecting that OpenRouter withdrew the model and it moved to OpenCode Zen's free lane. This change updates the picker grouping logic in the shared core to reflect current model availability status.

changes.what: Removed the recommended badge for Space Bunny Alpha from the model picker placements

7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.text: The assistant removed the recommended label from Space Bunny Alpha in the free model list because that option is no longer available from its previous provider. This adjustment affects anyone using the free tier of the coding assistant, ensuring the picker reflects which models are actually ready to use. You will simply see one fewer highlighted choice in the list; the model remains selectable, but it no longer appears as a top pick.

5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.text: Freebuff's fast-mode model is now available to everyone. The software now handles situations where the system's temporary storage is full or locked by loading its visual interface from a secondary location and showing clear instructions on how to free up space. When terminal commands fail due to that storage issue, the error message now tells you exactly what to do instead of just asking you to restart the app. If your session is ended by the system because another device took over or your purchase was refunded, the app stops retrying and tells you to start fresh instead of hanging for 14 seconds. The tool also automatically cleans up leftover temporary files from previous starts to prevent your storage from filling up over time.

3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.title: OpenTUI renderer fallback to config dir and temp cleanup
3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.summary: The CLI now pre-loads the OpenTUI native renderer using `ensureRenderLibrary` from the new `opentui-native-library` module. When the temp directory is full, read-only, or noexec, the library is installed into the CLI's config directory (content-addressed) and loaded from there; if that also fails, a descriptive `RenderLibraryLoadError` is thrown instead of the raw OpenTUI error. Additionally, `sweepLeakedRenderLibraryCopies` runs on a timer after startup to delete stale byte-identical copies of the renderer that Bun leaves in the temp directory, reclaiming disk space.

This helps advertisers understand how people engage with ads in the terminal so they can target placements more effectively. The team is also improving their internal testing process to make sure the new speed option works correctly before it is officially released.

0f5eda6e9e294d729f7798c7bf3d9263eeed44bc.text: Sponsored tasks in the Freebuff terminal can now enter Windows' Linux environment to run safe commands, provided they do not destroy databases or containers. Previously, any attempt to enter that environment was blocked entirely. This affects developers who accept and run advertiser-funded coding tasks in their terminal, ensuring those tasks have a little more flexibility to complete routine work without hitting an immediate wall. You will notice fewer rejections for harmless commands that previously required a Linux context, while destructive actions remain strictly blocked for your safety.

6931512368f9e246683b095dd2bf8ff43a811af8.title: BYOK lock recovery via PID check and loopback mutex
6931512368f9e246683b095dd2bf8ff43a811af8.summary: The BYOK metadata store lock in `sdk/src/byok.ts` now writes a PID to a candidate file and atomically links it to `connections.lock`, preventing stale empty locks that previously required manual deletion after a crash. The new `sdk/src/impl/byok-lock.ts` module provides `recoverByokLock`, which verifies a lock owner is dead using `process.kill` and a short-lived loopback TCP listener to serialize concurrent reapers. This prevents multiple processes from simultaneously unlinking a successor's lock file while ensuring live PIDs are never expired by age.

070fd4a6baea173b40e4e309a4705da3251cf1ba.text: The bring-your-own-key setup guide in the Freebuff terminal now shows four clear steps with copy-and-paste commands for the most common terminal programs, plus a specific note on how to write the key's name without extra symbols. dece3e47a9c94144be458cde89e5dd77fef57e80.text: Service operators now have a standardized data structure for backfilling archived message records into background storage. This update strictly applies to internal database maintenance and log reporting pipelines managed by service operators. It creates no visible changes or disruptions to how you interact with the assistant in daily use.

8ea9ab3e1f7758075f6ed807a54065e1ba89894a.title: BigQuery message row gains composite insert key and lookup fields
8ea9ab3e1f7758075f6ed807a54065e1ba89894a.summary: A new utility `messageInsertId` in `common/src/util/message-insert-id.ts` establishes the composite primary key for BigQuery `message` rows, formatted as the message id and user id joined by a pipe. The `MessageRow` type in `common/src/types/contracts/bigquery.ts` also gains six optional lookup fields (`client_request_id`, `client_id`, `agent_id`, `model`, `surface`, provider) to support admin trace viewers and migration scripts. The composite key prevents silent data loss from 32-bit completion id collisions across different users.

f6c9bf23ecd733d05db82bdabd99521388488a73.summary: The timezone resolution in `common/src/util/freebucks-timezone.ts` now delegates to `freebucksDeviceTimeZone` to prevent a server-side image default or ICU quirk from overwriting an account's schedule. This change adds a `FreebucksTimeZoneRuntime` interface and `isRemoteHost` detection to omit `x-fb-timezone` when the user is on a remote host, when the `TZ` environment variable causes Bun to answer UTC incorrectly, or when a Windows machine reports a fixed-offset zone instead of a named one. Two environment variables, `REMOTE_CONTAINERS` and `GITPOD_WORKSPACE_ID`, are newly included in the remote-host check so that development containers also drop the header rather than send a misleading UTC default.

changes.what: Introduces `FreebucksTimeZoneRuntime`, `isRemoteHost`, and `freebucksDeviceTimeZone` to filter out erroneous timezone signals from remote hosts and Windows. This updates `freebucksTimeZoneHeaders` to return an empty object instead of a UTC header when the device's zone is unreliable.

8ea9ab3e1f7758075f6ed807a54065e1ba89894a.text: The system now builds a unique file identifier for each chat record by combining the message number with the user's account number, preventing two different people from accidentally overwriting the same file if their numbers happen to match. The record also gains optional labels for the specific model, user, and device used, which help staff find and review conversations in their internal tools. This is a back-office data fix that ensures logs stay accurate; it does not change how you use the assistant or any of your settings.

f6c9bf23ecd733d05db82bdabd99521388488a73.text: The free coding assistant now leaves out its timezone guess when it is running in a remote environment, such as a development container or over a secure connection, because those systems often report a default setting rather than your actual location. It also withholds the time zone when your computer is set to a specific, non-naming offset that does not match your other devices, or when the underlying system cannot confidently identify your location. This stops the assistant from using an incorrect default to schedule your daily free credit refreshes. If no time zone is sent, your existing schedule remains unchanged; if one is sent, it must be the correct one.

d71a831b3a7a5b66a7a100a47a69c2c6bcc70d82.text: This release removes the automatic cleaning of text shown in the terminal when the AI assistant runs commands, meaning the output you see now displays exactly as the command or file produces it. The update also simplifies how the assistant handles free AI models like Muse Spark, adjusting their internal setup to reduce the number of separate requests made per conversation. Security protections for sponsored ad tasks were tightened, ensuring that only specific, approved tools can be used and that certain sensitive file paths are blocked from being modified. Additionally, the way the app identifies your device and processes ad-related information was updated to use consistent, server-verified signals rather than local guesses.

c3d72c61d37fd4193573c8facd2b9bdf892ad472.text: Solar Pro 4 is now free to use as a temporary promotion, moving from its previous paid spot to the free section of the model picker. The free period has no end date set, so the price will remain zero until a future update explicitly ends the promotion. Users who have set up their own AI provider connections will see clearer error messages if those connections are locked, deleted, or corrupted, instead of generic failures that might expose sensitive data. The software also standardizes how it recognizes project instruction files, ensuring that both the AI's internal prompt builder and its security checks use the exact same text to identify and skip your personal files safely.

5d02de3e8d4e79daafd09162f66356696ce4d15a.text: Freebuff 0.2.16 enables the server-side distribution of the DeepSeek Fast mode, making it available in the model catalog for new applications. The CLI now loads its terminal graphics from a safe location in your config directory if the temporary storage is full, read-only, or restricted, and it automatically deletes old, hidden copies of these graphics to prevent your temporary storage from filling up. When a terminal command fails because the temporary storage cannot hold the result, the app now shows a specific message telling you to free up space or change the temporary directory, instead of a generic error. The CLI stops retrying session refusals that will not change, such as when a session has ended or the per-turn spend limit has been reached, so you see the final message immediately rather than waiting for repeated attempts. The agent definitions used for free sessions now display the model's full name rather than a legacy identifier, and new tests verify that all built-in agents pass validation even when custom agents are loaded in your project.

In daily use, you can select Solar Pro 4 again from your model choices, and the system will remember your choice without forcing you to switch to the Mini 4 model.

95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.title: Freebuff 0.2.14: shared catalog compiled model resolver
95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.summary: The Freebuff CLI release 0.2.14 introduces `common/src/util/freebuff-catalog-compiled-model.ts`, which centralizes the mapping from server catalog rows to their legacy compiled model ids via `legacyDigests`. The CLI catalog agent now uses this shared utility to route fast-mode model rows to the `base3-fast` harness, and the model picker imports the resolver from the common package instead of a local duplicate. Four other changes in this release update the file-explorer agents to GPT-6 Luna, refine model picker sections, add a paused plan notice to the chat header, and prepare Convex to Postgres backend switches.

The release version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` is bumped to 0.2.14.

Updates the catalog agent builder to use the shared compiled model resolver and route fast-mode rows to the base3-fast harness.
Moves file-picker and file-lister agents to GPT-6 Luna with reasoning disabled.
Adds a persistent notice in the chat header when a subscription plan is paused due to a failed renewal payment.
Introduces backend switch constants for migrating affiliate and issue report data from Convex to Postgres.

bff551a315b23d079d428c40bd9e30c93aa4257c.text: Freebuff 0.2.13 adds an ad adoption watcher that tracks whether you install a developer tool after clicking an ad for it in the CLI. The release also expands the information used to measure how you interact with ads, now capturing typing patterns, tool usage, and your machine's performance to assess ad visibility. Your session details, including terminal size and system load, are now included in ad requests as coarse, privacy-bucketed data. A new /reasoning command is available in this release.

95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.title: Freebuff 0.2.14: shared catalog compiled model helper and fast-mode
95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.summary: Freebuff CLI 0.2.14 introduces a shared `compiledFreebuffModelIdOfRow` helper in the common package so both CLI and Desktop can resolve which compiled model a server-catalog row replaces via its legacy digests. The CLI's catalog root agent now uses this helper to determine whether a row should run on the `base3-fast` harness (with parallel fan-out) or the standard `base3` harness, passing the row's display name and compaction policy to `createBase3FastCliRoot` when appropriate. The model picker continues to use shared section grouping via `freebuffPickerSections` across all access tiers. Three other changes are included in this release window covering off-peak price display, paused-plan notices, and backend migration constants, but are not detailed here.
95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.evidence: The diff moves `compiledFreebuffModelIdOfRow` from `cli/src/utils/freebuff-model-directory.ts` into a new `common/src/util/freebuff-catalog-compiled-model.ts` module, and updates `freebuffCatalogRootAgent` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-catalog-agent.ts` to use it to select between `createBase3FastCliRoot` and `createBase3CliRoot` based on whether the row's compiled id is a fast-mode model.
95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.unknowns: The release notes indicate 29 other changes were omitted; their specific behaviors are not described here.

changes.what: New `compiledFreebuffModelIdOfRow` helper resolves a server-catalog row's compiled model id from its legacy digests for use by CLI and Desktop.
Catalog root agent now selects between fast-mode and standard harness based on the row's compiled model id, passing model label and compaction to `createBase3FastCliRoot`.
Model directory removes its local copy of `compiledFreebuffModelIdOfRow` in favor of the shared common-package export.
CLI release manifest bumped from 0.2.13 to 0.2.14.

95ecda2ed3026dfa12214335ce0a2b6f4732208d.text: Freebuff 0.2.14 introduces DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast as a new free model option available to all full-access users. This fast-mode model splits coding work across parallel background tasks to handle large, repetitive code changes more efficiently, and it is priced at 50 Freebucks per hour during peak weekday windows. The model picker now organizes the free model list into three clear sections - Unlimited, Optimized, and Powerful - so you can easily see what each group of models is for and which ones are recommended for their section. The CLI now displays a warning when a paid plan is paused due to a failed renewal payment, with a direct link to update your payment method. Background file-searching tasks now run on the GPT-6 Luna model instead of the previous Gemini-based tools, which keeps their usage out of your session's model quota. For Freebucks metering, the picker now shows when off-peak pricing will resume during peak hours so you know when to wait for a cheaper rate.

c4c3acc994a682348b5642bc7a0d2064462ff15d.title: Add daily frequency cap for billboard ad placements
c4c3acc994a682348b5642bc7a0d2064462ff15d.summary: The billboard module in the shared ads package now defines a daily frequency cap for ad impressions. The `BILLBOARD_DAILY_FREQUENCY_CAP` constant sets a maximum of 5 impressions per user, campaign, and slot within a 24-hour rolling window. This cap is designed to replace the previous hourly caps, which counted serves rather than screen time, preventing a single campaign from holding a billboard slot for extended periods despite the 15-minute refresh cycle.
c4c3acc994a682348b5642bc7a0d2064462ff15d.evidence: New constant `BILLBOARD_DAILY_FREQUENCY_CAP` added to `common/src/ads/billboard.ts`, defining a `maxImpressions` of 5 and a `windowMs` of 24 hours for billboard ad placements.
c4c3acc994a682348b5642bc7a0d2064462ff15d.unknowns: The diff does not show the implementation logic that enforces this cap in the serving pipeline, only the constant definition and its documentation.

03df0d8b1f0fb0d9a00ec7994c4eb57f3fc516cc.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.11 releases deferred update adoption and launcher
03df0d8b1f0fb0d9a00ec7994c4eb57f3fc516cc.summary: The Freebuff CLI release manifest in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumps the version to `0.2.11`, packaging the launcher's new deferred update adoption logic that adopts orphaned staged updates when the terminal window is closed, rather than leaving users on an old build. The npm wrapper now sets `CODEBUFF_LAUNCHER_VERSION` when spawning the binary, and the CLI includes the first 32 characters of that value in the `APP_LAUNCHED` telemetry event to distinguish install paths that can and cannot adopt terminal-closed updates.

The release member evidence shows `cli/release-core/launcher.js` adding `adoptOrphanedStagedUpdates` and `writeStagedManifest` to handle deferred updates when terminal windows are closed, and `cli/src/index.tsx` adding `launcherVersion` to the `APP_LAUNCHED` telemetry event.

05b8302ce19e998ea16f2f38c400c62c94d974b7.summary: The release manifest in freebuff/cli/release/package.json advances the version field from 0.2.9 to 0.2.10. This commit packages the changes released in the preceding 0.2.9 cycle, including SDK DNS pinning, landing ads, and sponsored git updates.

0cb910451c1b774876b017cf60f059ed6e9f2e82.title: Freebuff 0.2.12 adds Space Bunny Alpha to limited access and retires
0cb910451c1b774876b017cf60f059ed6e9f2e82.summary: The 0.2.12 release adds `Space Bunny Alpha` to the limited-access picker via `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS` and introduces `FREEBUFF_RETIRED_MODEL_IDS`, which lists `MiniMax M3`, `GLM 5.2`, and `OX Alpha` as no longer served on Freebuff agents. The `freebuffRetiredModelMessage` function instructs users to update their client, as older CLI versions were still requesting retired models like `MiniMax M3` on `base2-free`. Limited-access documentation in the README and release notes now includes `Space Bunny Alpha` alongside the existing limited-access models.

dfec4965e1fca35dbd60e69e1ce8d3f2ac90a605.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.9 adds DNS pinning, terminal sanitization and git
dfec4965e1fca35dbd60e69e1ce8d3f2ac90a605.summary: Freebuff CLI 0.2.9 closes a DNS rebinding gap in the SDK read_url tool by adding a new pinnedFetch transport in sdk/src/tools/pinned-fetch.ts that validates and connects to addresses in a single resolution step, alongside five other changes. The release also restores terminal output sanitization in the CLI, reintroduces landing screen ad gating based on terminal height, and extends sponsored-run security controls to refuse git history subcommands and deeply nested wrapper chains. A new shouldHideGravityAds helper now centralizes ad visibility logic in the CLI hook. The version manifest is bumped to 0.2.9 in freebuff/cli/release/package.json.

changes.what: Adds DNS pinning to the read_url tool via a new pinnedFetch transport and expanded SSRF blocked ranges to prevent rebinding attacks.
Restores terminal output sanitization to strip escape sequences from commands and tool results before rendering them in the UI.
Reintroduces terminal-height gating for landing screen ads so that the banner and ad fetch are disabled on compact terminals below 18 rows.
Extends sponsored-run command refusals to block git history-moving subcommands and deeply nested wrapper chains that fail closed as unverifiable.
Bumps the Freebuff CLI release version to 0.2.9 in the package manifest.

c4c3acc994a682348b5642bc7a0d2064462ff15d.text: The free coding tool now sets a new limit for large, full-screen ads shown on the desktop app, capping how many times a single ad from one company can appear to you each day. This internal update protects advertisers and sponsors who pay for these ad spaces, ensuring no single company dominates the screen for extended periods. Since this change only sets a new rule and does not yet enforce it in the live system, you will not notice any immediate difference in how the tool behaves.

03df0d8b1f0fb0d9a00ec7994c4eb57f3fc516cc.text: Freebuff CLI 0.2.11 fixes a bug where closing your terminal window before the app finished shutting down would prevent software updates from installing, leaving you on an older version indefinitely. The update now saves your downloaded changes to disk if the terminal is closed abruptly, ensuring your next launch automatically adopts the new version without needing to re-download it. Additionally, the release includes new automated tests that verify the assistant correctly handles external tools requiring specific input fields, confirming that missing arguments are properly caught before sending commands to external software.

0cb910451c1b774876b017cf60f059ed6e9f2e82.text: Space Bunny Alpha is now available in limited access for users outside full-access regions, joining the existing free models. Freebuff now retires three models (MiniMax M3, GLM 5.2, and Ox Alpha), showing a clear update prompt if you try to use them, instead of silently failing. The daily streak and Freebucks meter now reset at your local midnight rather than Pacific time, so your bonus and allowance align with your actual day. Security checks now block downloaded agents that include executable tools or servers unless the publisher is explicitly trusted, and Windows can find Git even if it is not on your system path.

05b8302ce19e998ea16f2f38c400c62c94d974b7.text: The free coding assistant received a version update that brings together recent improvements to make it safer and more stable. This update includes stricter checks for how the program connects to online services, cleaner handling of certain text outputs, and better safeguards against specific types of commands that could interfere with the system. These changes help ensure the tool works reliably and securely for anyone using the free service, without requiring you to change anything in your daily workflow.

dfec4965e1fca35dbd60e69e1ce8d3f2ac90a605.text: This update tightens security for Freebuff users by preventing the tool that reads web pages from being tricked into accessing your private computer or internal networks. It also stops hidden terminal tricks from running when the assistant shows you output from commands or files. When you use a sponsored task that runs on your own computer, the assistant now blocks commands that would change your code history or erase your databases, ensuring your work stays safe and uncommitted for you to review. Finally, the main screen now only requests ads when there is actually enough space to show them, so it does not waste your data or cause unnecessary loading on small screens.

c5c0acc93f8fec48e0f7f78c536c4ed6dea74a2c.title: Streak bonus line labels reader clock and compact fallback
c5c0acc93f8fec48e0f7f78c536c4ed6dea74a2c.summary: The Freebuff CLI streak bonus status line now labels clock times as the reader's local time to prevent misinterpretation of server-side reset hours. The common streak module gains `labelReaderClock` and `compact` parameters, allowing the CLI to prefer the labeled version and fall back to an unlabeled version when terminal width is insufficient. This release also includes agent-runtime logic to nudge unfinished to-dos before ending a turn on followups, and a model image support overlay fix.
c5c0acc93f8fec48e0f7f78c536c4ed6dea74a2c.evidence: The diff adds `labelReaderClock` and `compact` parameters to `formatFreebuffStreakResetTime` and `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatus` in `common/src/util/freebuff-streak-line.ts`, and refactors `getFreebuffStreakBonusStatusForLayout` in `cli/src/utils/freebuff-streak-line.ts` to retry with the compact flag when the labeled line is too wide. This commit is part of release 0.2.7 which also includes agent-runtime follow-up nudge logic and model image support overlay updates.
c5c0acc93f8fec48e0f7f78c536c4ed6dea74a2c.unknowns: The diff does not show the specific consumer of the new `labelReaderClock` flag outside the CLI and common module.

changes.what: The CLI streak layout logic now retries with a compact flag to fit narrow terminals.
The common streak utility supports labeling clock times as the reader's local time.
A new follow-up todo nudge mechanism prevents the agent from ending turns with unfinished tasks.
Model image support now reads from a server catalog overlay to handle multimodal capabilities correctly.
The release manifest version is bumped to 0.2.7.

d71a831b3a7a5b66a7a100a47a69c2c6bcc70d82.title: Revert terminal output sanitization in CLI and remove sponsored
d71a831b3a7a5b66a7a100a47a69c2c6bcc70d82.summary: Freebuff CLI 0.2.8 removes the terminal output sanitization mechanism, deleting the `sanitizeTerminalOutput` function from `common/src/util/terminal-safe-text.ts` and stripping its calls from the tool display components so that terminal command strings and tool results are no longer stripped of escape sequences before rendering. This release also deletes the sponsored proposal conformance, verification, and Supabase setup invitation modules from `common/src/ads/`, along with the Cloudflare Worker signals and disposable email detection utilities, shrinking the shared ad infrastructure surface. No functional alternative for terminal sanitization is introduced in this diff.

changes.what: Removes terminal output sanitization, deleting `sanitizeTerminalOutput` from `common/src/util/terminal-safe-text.ts` and all its call sites in CLI tool display components.
Deletes the sponsored proposal conformance matrix, verification rubric, Supabase setup invitation, and Supabase CPC experiment modules from the common ads subsystem.
Removes the Cloudflare Worker egress detection module, the disposable email domain classification module, and the spend provider constants from the shared package.
Updates comments in agent definitions, SDK LLM implementations, and sponsored execution modules, and removes the Freebuff cost-mode escalation constants and spend ceiling notices.

c5c0acc93f8fec48e0f7f78c536c4ed6dea74a2c.text: Freebuff now keeps you informed about when your daily streak rewards are credited or expire by labeling clock times with "(your time)" so you know the hour is on your local watch, not the server's. If your terminal is too narrow for that extra text, the app drops the label but still shows the time. The AI assistant now checks its own to-do list before ending a task on a "continue" prompt; if items remain unfinished, it nudge itself to keep working instead of handing the work back to you mid-plan. This check stops after a few attempts or if no progress is made, preventing the assistant from getting stuck in a loop. Image support for certain models is now determined by live server data rather than static local lists, which prevents errors when text-only models receive images they cannot process.

d71a831b3a7a5b66a7a100a47a69c2c6bcc70d82.text: The command-line assistant now strips invisible control codes from program output before displaying it, preventing external content from silently changing your terminal settings or clipboard. The interface for running terminal commands and displaying their results has been updated to apply this cleaning step consistently. The free model catalog now identifies itself to ad networks using a shared browser-like label, ensuring that impressions recorded by the server match the initial ad request for accurate targeting. Security protections for advertiser-funded tasks running on Windows were refined to use a consistent containment method, and the system for verifying those tasks now relies on deterministic checks rather than allowing the task executor to claim success. The release also includes updated instructions for the AI agent that clarifies how it should handle user interactions and tool usage.

055e9c3cd792ca332c6838f1f47c12415c638f54.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.5 release
055e9c3cd792ca332c6838f1f47c12415c638f54.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.2.5 is published, packaging the auth logging deduplication and the spend-limited landing screen split for ID verification. The auth module now tracks distinct credentials read and parse failures in a bounded set, logging each unique error once instead of repeating it on every app shell render, which resolves excessive log ingestion caused by stale clients reading moved token files. The freebuff-landing-screen component now renders an identity verification prompt when the session admission response includes the new `verificationRequired` flag, separating it from the daily usage cap message. The release manifest version field in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` is updated to `0.2.5`.

The release member evidence includes a deduplication mechanism in `cli/src/utils/auth.ts` using `loggedCredentialsFailures` to prevent repeated logging, and a new `verificationRequired` flag in `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` that distinguishes ID verification from budget limits in the landing screen.

985c872eb8d43f538ab77d933ef7c43125d100ff.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.3 supports history paging from recalled drafts
985c872eb8d43f538ab77d933ef7c43125d100ff.summary: The Freebuff CLI release manifest in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumps the version from 0.2.2 to 0.2.3. 44c800d2617286631654dfd4d3c7b2b0e8e4d6b4.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.6: MiMo 2.6 Flash default and limited plan rows
44c800d2617286631654dfd4d3c7b2b0e8e4d6b4.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.2.6 is published with MiMo 2.6 Flash replacing GLM 5.3 Flash as the default model across all surfaces and tiers. The change sets `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID`, `DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_WEB_MODEL_ID`, and `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_HERO_MODEL_ID` to `FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID`, while explicitly leaving `PREVIOUS_DEFAULT_FREEBUFF_MODEL_ID` unchanged so that saved GLM picks are not migrated. At limited access, the catalog now lists plan-only rows to planless accounts, drawing them as locked via a new `accessTier` fallback in `freebuffPlanRequired` when the server sends no `planRequiredModelIds` verdict.

8067376238835ba774fd0a5f761ff1c298f1711f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.4 adds keychain auth and server model catalog
8067376238835ba774fd0a5f761ff1c298f1711f.summary: The Freebuff CLI now stores its auth token in the OS credential store (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or Linux Secret Service) via `Bun.secrets` instead of the plain `credentials.json` file, driven by the new `loadStoredAuthToken` startup call and `auth-token-store` module, with the token falling back to the file if the keychain is unavailable. Simultaneously, the CLI introduces a server-driven model catalog protocol (`freebuff-model-catalog.ts`) where models are referenced by opaque rotating handles rather than compiled-in IDs, with a new single root agent `base3-free-catalog` built at runtime from catalog rows, plus a `FreebuffModelPolicyOverlay` seam allowing the server to override pricing, session limits, and effort ladders without client releases. The version is bumped from 0.2.3 to 0.2.4 in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`.
8067376238835ba774fd0a5f761ff1c298f1711f.evidence: In `cli/src/index.tsx`, `loadStoredAuthToken` is called before credential reads to initialize a new OS keychain-backed token store (`cli/src/utils/auth-token-store.ts`) for Freebuff, while `agents/base3.ts` and `common/src/types/freebuff-model-catalog.ts` introduce a server-driven model catalog protocol and a new `base3-free-catalog` root agent.
