055e9c3cd792ca332c6838f1f47c12415c638f54.text: Freebuff CLI version 0.2.5 adds a new screen that asks you to verify your identity if the server flags your account, showing a link to complete the verification instead of displaying a generic reset time. The release also improves the logging system so that repeated errors from unreadable credential files appear only once per session, preventing the program from filling up its logs with identical warnings every second. Additionally, the application now tightens file permissions on your saved login data whenever it starts up, ensuring that only your user account can read those files on non-Windows systems. This security check automatically fixes any existing files that were previously saved with looser permissions, without affecting your active login.

985c872eb8d43f538ab77d933ef7c43125d100ff.text: Freebuff CLI version 0.2.3 updates how you navigate your chat history. Previously, you could only scroll through past messages when your input field was completely empty. Now, if you recall a previous message and have not typed any new characters into it, you can continue scrolling up and down to browse older or newer entries. If you type into the recalled message, the up and down arrow keys return to their normal function of moving the cursor within the text. This change applies to both standard chat history and command line history within the interface.

44c800d2617286631654dfd4d3c7b2b0e8e4d6b4.text: Freebuff CLI 0.2.6 makes MiMo 2.6 Flash the default AI model for new users, replacing GLM 5.3 Flash as the starting selection in the model picker. For users in limited-access regions or on VPNs, the model list now displays options that require a paid plan as locked rows instead of hiding them, so you can see the upgrade path directly in the terminal. The CLI now signs communication requests with a unique device key to verify that each session request matches the specific model catalog you are using. When you switch between paid models in a multi-session workflow, the system now correctly applies discount reservations to the new model instead of releasing them when the previous session ends. These updates ensure that model availability and pricing details in the terminal match the server's rules, preventing selections that would be rejected by the service.

8067376238835ba774fd0a5f761ff1c298f1711f.text: Freebuff CLI 0.2.4 introduces a server-driven model catalog and safer credential storage. The release adds a new way to fetch available AI models directly from the service, meaning the list of free and paid options you see in the app can update without you needing to download a new version of the CLI. Your login security token is now stored in your computer's secure keychain instead of a plain text file, which reduces the risk that other programs on your machine can read your login details. If the secure keychain is not available on your system, the tool automatically falls back to the old file-based method so you are never locked out. These changes work together to keep your session secure while allowing the app to serve new model options and pricing changes instantly.

2cde35ae5aa49b2646042d97c6d7113102d1836e.text: This release focuses on stopping you from being silently switched to a different AI model when you hit a daily usage limit. Previously, if a model's daily quota ran out, the system would quietly fall back to a different, available model without telling you. Now, if the daily limit is reached, the session stops and clearly informs you that the limit is spent, ensuring you are not charged for or routed to a model you did not intend to use. The bring-your-own-key feature now provides much more helpful error messages when connecting your own API keys. If your connection fails because of a wrong model name, a missing environment variable, or a bad URL, the error text will specifically name what is wrong (for example, which environment variable is missing or which models the provider actually lists) instead of giving a generic failure message. The system also now detects when pasted commands contain accidental line breaks that split words, and will automatically repair them if the break pattern exactly matches the expected number of arguments, preventing broken configuration updates. Additionally, the error handling for AI models that use external tools has been improved to correctly process responses from providers that omit specific tool identifiers, preventing tool calls from being silently lost during a conversation.

64e8d89a859503189b368484b0a43f37db4a1d11.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.1 adds terminal environment and input profile
64e8d89a859503189b368484b0a43f37db4a1d11.summary: Release 0.2.1 introduces a compact terminal environment descriptor and per-prompt input counts so ad auction and session requests carry client context for targeting and bot filtering. The `x-freebuff-env` header, built in `cli/src/utils/client-environment.ts`, reports terminal program buckets, TTY status, color reply, and ancestor process kinds without raw values. The `input-profile.ts` module tracks typed characters, keypress events, and paste counts, encoding them as `freebuff_input_profile` metadata on chat runs. These descriptors are attached to ad requests in `ad-request.ts` and session calls in `freebuff-session-api.ts`.

Release member b6925d13 introduces `cli/src/utils/client-environment.ts` and `cli/src/utils/input-profile.ts`, which define the `x-freebuff-env` header and `codebuff_metadata` input profile fields, wired into `buildAdAuctionRequest` and `callFreebuffSession` so ad and session requests carry terminal and typing context.

e3e17a08d4f583cce97ad9e6c59f37516431dae4.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast now plan-locked at limited access
e3e17a08d4f583cce97ad9e6c59f37516431dae4.summary: The entitlement rules in the shared model catalog changed so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast is no longer unavailable at limited access, but instead requires a paid plan, matching the terms of GPT-6 Luna and MiMo 2.6 Pro. In `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, the constant `FREEBUFF_FULL_ACCESS_ONLY_MODEL_IDS` and its predicate `isFreebuffFullAccessOnlyModelId` were removed, and the model ID was added to `FREEBUFF_LIMITED_TIER_PLAN_ONLY_MODEL_IDS` and `FREEBUFF_PLAN_METERED_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS` through the new internal array `FAST_MODE_PLAN_MODEL_IDS`. This allows limited-tier subscribers to unlock the fast-mode harness, while unpaid limited accounts see it locked. The English and Chinese READMEs and the CLI release readme were updated to reflect the new access tier.
e3e17a08d4f583cce97ad9e6c59f37516431dae4.evidence: In `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`, the constants `FREEBUFF_FULL_ACCESS_ONLY_MODEL_IDS` and the function `isFreebuffFullAccessOnlyModelId` are deleted, and `FREEBUFF_DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_FAST_MODEL_ID` is appended to `FREEBUFF_LIMITED_TIER_PLAN_ONLY_MODEL_IDS` and `FREEBUFF_PLAN_METERED_CATALOG_MODEL_IDS` via the new internal helper `FAST_MODE_PLAN_MODEL_IDS`. This is mirrored in `README.md`, `README.zh-CN.md`, and `freebuff/cli/release/README.md` where the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast access description changes from "Full access only" to "Full access; paid plans at limited access".

A second read of the same diff did not confirm that a migration step is required.

Updated the model access description for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Fast in the documentation and release artifacts.

64e8d89a859503189b368484b0a43f37db4a1d11.text: This release introduces a compact, privacy-conscious profile of your terminal environment and typing habits to the Freebuff service. The profile uses fixed, broad categories for your terminal type, window size, and process ancestry, explicitly avoiding the transmission of specific file paths or raw text. A new input counter tracks how your prompts are composed, distinguishing between individually typed characters and pasted text, along with typing speed metrics. These counts are attached to your submitted prompts to help the service understand interaction patterns. Additionally, all ad-related requests now include this environment summary to improve how ads are targeted and filtered. The system also recognizes and displays a specific error message when a model provider flags a request for potential cybersecurity risks, advising you to try a different model since retrying with the same conversation will fail.

e3e17a08d4f583cce97ad9e6c59f37516431dae4.text: Starting October 5, 2026, the fast variant of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moved from being completely unavailable in restricted regions to requiring a paid subscription for those users. Users in supported regions retain free access to this fast option, while users in restricted areas can now use it only if they have a paid plan, matching the terms of similar advanced models. The model picker in the Freebuff interface now displays this fast option to restricted users with a lock icon until a plan is active, reflecting the new access rules in both English and Chinese documentation.

e99feb7a839f91163e4dae51c0ab017b40f82563.title: Freebuff CLI 0.1.11 adds truncated write guard and release manifest
e99feb7a839f91163e4dae51c0ab017b40f82563.summary: This release bumps the Freebuff CLI manifest to 0.1.11. f8c7a1ad8f21d84791d5bfd94277c937aa6d9f3f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.1.10 adds subscription billing and MRR helpers
f8c7a1ad8f21d84791d5bfd94277c937aa6d9f3f.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.1.10 bumps the package manifest and introduces shared constants for paid subscription tiers with annual billing support. The update adds freebuffSubscriptionBillingInterval to parse billing cadence from free text, defaulting to monthly for unknown values to prevent errors. It also adds freebuffSubscriptionMrrUsd to compute recurring revenue, applying a twelfth divisor for yearly plans and returning 0 for grants or unlisted tiers.

e99feb7a839f91163e4dae51c0ab017b40f82563.text: This release introduces a protective check that stops the AI assistant from accidentally overwriting your files with incomplete code. Previously, if an AI response hit its length limit while trying to save a large file, it could leave the code on your computer in a broken, half-finished state. Now, the assistant recognizes when a file change is cut off or unusually short and refuses to apply it, keeping your original code exactly as it was. It also improves how it explains these situations to itself, telling it to make smaller, more careful changes instead of trying to send the same large command that failed. Finally, the release includes internal logging updates that let the service operators see exactly when these protective blocks happen, without storing the actual contents of your files.

e675e2ef35e2b55f3338ee522fb12cfd263470d9.text: Freebuff CLI version 0.2.0 adjusts how it tracks and uses AI models and pay-as-you-go credits. The default thinking effort for Muse Spark has been reduced to save time, and GPT-6 Luna no longer offers its highest reasoning tier. GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash now have their reasoning depths capped or fixed. When you use multiple sessions at once, the system now calculates potential savings from your current purchases more accurately. The new user questionnaire shuffles answer choices to prevent bias. Several new AI models, including GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol, are now available with specific pricing and usage rules.

f8c7a1ad8f21d84791d5bfd94277c937aa6d9f3f.text: You can now set a preferred reasoning effort level for your own API key connections, letting you choose low, medium, or high effort, or leave it to the provider's default. If a provider rejects your chosen effort, the system automatically retries the request without that setting and remembers the rejection for that specific connection to avoid repeated errors. New helper tools were added to calculate monthly recurring revenue for paid subscriptions, ensuring annual plans are correctly counted as one-twelfth of their yearly price. These subscription metrics also allow administrators to view paying subscribers split by their billing cadence, separating monthly from yearly users in internal reports. The release also includes a subscription billing experiment that assigns users to either monthly or yearly billing views.

afe1bfdf35f46fa3a26160855494e968ed5420c7.text: Freebuff 0.1.9 introduces GPT-6.1 Sol as a newly available model in the picker, where it is free to use in the United States and available on paid plans in other locations. You are limited to one session with GPT-6.1 Sol per day on any plan. Ad links in sponsored proposals are now automatically tagged so advertisers can tell their analytics when a visit came from Freebuff, but only when the link lacks its own existing tags. The application now tracks whether you return to Freebuff after clicking an ad by watching for your next prompt, your next click, or the window regaining focus. This helps the ad system understand how long you stayed on the advertiser's page before coming back to code.

f93daaf339a2cd84e01d8695bd8e091a6d2dc0ad.text: Freebuff 0.1.8 adds a new ad space that appears when you are planning to launch, ship, or deploy your project, sitting just above the text input field. The daily Freebucks bonus from your activity streak now counts toward your daily allowance instead of your saved credit wallet, meaning it expires when the daily reset happens and will not build up over time. The on-screen text has been updated to tell you exactly when that bonus is active and when it will go away, so you can see when it expires in your local time. A permanent notice about model availability changes has been removed from the main landing screen, leaving the space cleaner. Additionally, a new price tracking measure was added for advertisers to account for specific types of impression billing that are handled outside the main system.

a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.title: Release 0.0.203 adds binary elision and end-based rewind counts
a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.summary: Release 0.0.203 of the Freebuff CLI bundles updates to the agent runtime's compaction logic and the SDK's run-state rewind mechanics. In `packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts`, a `JSON.stringify` replacer now substitutes base64 and data-URL media payloads with named omissions instead of serializing their bytes, preventing massive token counts during model summarization. In `sdk/src/compact-run-state.ts`, `truncateRunStateAtUserTurn` now accepts an optional `totalUserTurns` parameter to calculate the rewind boundary by counting `USER_PROMPT` tags backward from the end of the message history.

dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.202 release with 402 out-of-credits fix
dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.summary: Freebuff CLI 0.0.202 bumps the version in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` and packages the update where `isFreebuffProviderUsageError` now skips provider-billing classification when the error message matches `CODEBUFF_OWN_CREDITS_ERROR_PATTERN`, which detects the Codebuff usage page URL and routes it to the ordinary out-of-credits flow instead of a provider refill message. The 402 response previously matched both the out-of-credits flow and the provider usage error pattern, causing incorrect messaging for paying users. 38cd1ed44428f573c4754d8e0cee868f2875b54e.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.204 release with crash telemetry and session resume
38cd1ed44428f573c4754d8e0cee868f2875b54e.summary: Release 0.0.204 packages the new fatal crash reporting mechanism where the CLI writes a bounded crash report locally and ships it on the next launch. External exit signals like SIGHUP or SIGTERM now keep an active Freebuff session slot so the next launch can resume the purchased hour instead of releasing it. The release also refactors the CLI claim prefix to use a shared constant and adds a helper function to identify CLI claims.

The member diff in `cli/src/utils/fatal-crash-report.ts` introduces `takePreviousFatalCrash` and `recordFatalCrashSync` to ship previous-launch fatal crash telemetry on the next startup, while `cli/src/utils/renderer-cleanup.ts` adds `CLI_RENDERER_EXIT_SIGNALS` to ignore SIGPIPE and `handleExternalExit` to preserve active Freebuff sessions on external signals.

f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.201 release with legacy hour resume and partner ad
f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.summary: Freebuff CLI version `0.0.201` ships a legacy hour resume mechanism in the `use-freebuff-session` hook that probes for dead local process owners via `deadLegacyFreebuffOwner` to prevent duplicate purchases when an old launcher updates a pre-multi-session binary. The release also introduces two new partner ad slots, `Desktop-Partner-Skill-Picker` and `Desktop-Partner-Composer-PR`, in the shared constants package, marked with available: false to restrict them to first-party CPM delivery only. The partner format is explicitly excluded from the sponsor break predicate to prevent inheriting hero image requirements and daily caps designed for interrupting breaks.

Release member evidence shows `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` adding `deadLegacyFreebuffOwner` probing logic and `common/src/constants/freebuff-placements.ts` introducing the `partner` format and two new slots: `Desktop-Partner-Skill-Picker` and `Desktop-Partner-Composer-PR`.

a23f0ae16d9c7d69458dce20ca74178bc530ffb8.text: This update fixes two major issues that caused the assistant to lose conversation history or freeze. First, when the assistant summarizes a long session to save space, it now skips over raw image and file data that was previously copied into the text, stopping the freezing behavior that happened when screenshots were processed. Second, when you edit a past message to retry an answer, the system now correctly counts only your actual prompts rather than internal system notes, so it no longer accidentally deletes most of your conversation history. This ensures that editing your chat in a long session preserves your previous instructions and context instead of starting the assistant over from scratch.

38cd1ed44428f573c4754d8e0cee868f2875b54e.text: Freebuff CLI 0.0.204 adds crash telemetry and session resume capabilities. If the program suddenly stops due to an error, it now saves a short record locally so the next time you open it, that report is automatically sent to the service for review. When the terminal is closed or the process is killed by the system instead of exiting normally, any active paid hour you were using is preserved so it can be resumed in the next launch rather than being lost. The program also handles internal display errors more gracefully, so a glitch in the interface no longer kills the entire coding session. These changes help ensure your paid session time is not wasted by unexpected exits and provide developers with better data on what causes crashes.

dbc6a776fc0f8005806d797c00fe2c6caf1781c6.text: This update fixes a billing error that incorrectly told paying users their credit shortage was a service fault. Previously, a message telling you to add credits to your personal account was mistaken for a provider outage, which incorrectly displayed a notice saying the issue was on the service side. Now, when your own balance runs low, you will see the standard out-of-credits message and be directed to your account page to add funds. This ensures that free tier users are not billed for provider costs, while paying users receive the correct instructions for managing their own subscriptions.

f783139ae5607e7b53e6dd5608186d133930d7bd.text: This release adds support for two new exclusive ad spaces in the desktop app that are reserved for single-partner campaigns, and ensures that when you upgrade from an older version, your existing free coding session resumes automatically instead of asking you to buy a new one. The new ad slots appear as a row in the skill picker and a pill above the composer, drawing attention to specific advertiser content without interrupting your workflow. These partner spaces are strictly limited to one advertiser at a time, meaning they will not show up in the standard ad selection tools for other buyers. When you update the app, it now checks if a previous, older version left a free coding hour active on the server. If it finds one, it takes over that session safely, preventing you from being charged or blocked while the old background process finishes closing. The app also now records which specific user account was using the session, ensuring that if multiple accounts share a computer, one user's update does not accidentally interfere with another user's active work.

e4a960f781aeb3023a406e4990b741212d0cafce.text: Freebuff 0.1.0 adds partner ads to the terminal interface and corrects the promotional copy for the paid Starter plan. The terminal now displays single-line advertisements from specific advertisers in two locations: above the text input when you are writing about pull requests or code reviews, and directly under the /review command. These ad rows are drawn in the advertiser's chosen brand colors and include a visible "Ad" label, and they do not appear if ads are disabled or if the current ad deal is not active for your account. The internal promotional text for the Freebuff Starter subscription has been fixed to accurately name the plan instead of the more expensive Pro tier, and it now clearly states the extra session time in hours. The database monitoring threshold for detecting stuck background tasks was raised from 1 million to 10 million transactions to prevent false alarms during normal daily operations. The /model command remains available, but the /reasoning command is not part of this release.

9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.199 with Solar Pro 4 and ad trace pointer
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.summary: Solar Pro 4 returns to the free model picker, listing it beside Solar Mini 4 in both full and limited access, and its row in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts is updated to use the new SOLAR_PRO_4_OFFER constant with a 10 Freebucks price. The ad request flow now sends traceContext pointer ids via a dedicated adTraceContext store field instead of reading from runState, so interrupted runs advance the trace pointer. The CLI also resumes a crashed session's hour by writing a per-PID live record and, on restart, only claiming it if the original process is dead and the hour has not expired.
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.evidence: The release commit 9f521ec5 bumps freebuff/cli/release/package.json to 0.0.199, while member commit 7f957e9d restores SOLAR_PRO_4_MODEL to FREEBUFF_MODELS in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts and adds it to LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS; member 29214dea pins adTraceContext in cli/src/state/chat-store.ts; and member 2417e0d7 adds consumeCrashedFreebuffSession to cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-relaunch.ts.
9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side handling of the new adTraceContext field or the specific conditions under which a crashed session's hour is deemed expired.

baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.200 release
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.0.200 publishes the package version bump in `freebuff/cli/release/package.json`. This release includes a Linux-specific clipboard fallback hint that extends the toast duration to 6000 ms when native clipboard tools are unavailable. It also ships strict credential declaration parsing for sponsored runs, narrowing partner data-evaluation copy in the README and privacy constants to connected Cloud repositories only.
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.evidence: The commit bumps `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` from `0.0.199` to `0.0.200`. The release notes cite the clipboard fallback, sponsored credential injection, and data-use copy changes included in this version window.
baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.unknowns: The specific 8 omitted changes from the release window are not detailed in the diff.

9f521ec5f2e38db447cafa0549633d728a284921.text: Freebuff CLI 0.0.199 brings Solar Pro 4 back to the free model picker, where it sits beside Solar Mini 4 with 524K context, text-only access, and no session cost at full access. This release also saves your active free session hour to disk while you work; if the app crashes or the terminal closes, your next launch can resume that same hour instead of waiting for it to expire or buying a new one. In addition, every ad now carries only two anonymous identifiers pointing to the conversation it appears in; no message text or code is sent along, and the system keeps track of interrupted runs so the next ad does not accidentally reference a task that never finished.

baffcb89339ea373a63aa77202bec34e76f80444.text: Sponsored tasks can now connect to your own service accounts through secure, temporary login keys that stay hidden from the AI while it works. To keep your computer safe, the assistant now blocks sponsored tasks from running commands that could damage your databases, start or stop your background services, or access your separate personal Linux environment. If you copy text while working in a Linux terminal that lacks standard clipboard tools, the app now shows a hint to help you install the necessary software instead of claiming the copy succeeded. The privacy notice has been updated to clarify that advertising partners may only review connected cloud repositories and cannot use that data to train their own models. The available release evidence is incomplete, as eight other changes were excluded from this summary due to verification checks.

5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.197 defers launcher updates and adds multi-session
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.summary: Freebuff CLI release 0.0.197 ships deferred launcher updates that stage binary changes in per-process temp directories and install only on session exit via the new deferUpdatesUntilExit flag. The release also introduces multi-session CLI identity using the `cli:` instance ID prefix and new wire headers including FREEBUFF_MULTI_SESSION_HEADER, FREEBUFF_PURCHASE_CONTINUITY_HEADER, and FREEBUFF_DESKTOP_ATTEMPT_HEADER in the session API client. Active sessions now route Freebucks price quotes to the desktop purchase store when they carry a CLI multi-session attempt ID, distinguishing them from legacy single-session trial paths.
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.evidence: freebuff/cli/release/package.json hunk changing version from 0.0.196 to 0.0.197, plus release member source in freebuff/cli/release/index.js and cli/release-core/launcher.js adding deferred update logic and new headers in cli/src/utils/freebuff-session-api.ts.
5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side implementation for the new multi-session headers or the specific conditions under which the desktop purchase store routing changes user billing behavior.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.198 in-place sponsored proposals
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.summary: Release 0.0.198 of the Freebuff CLI removes the `/ads:pull-request` and `/ads:remove-worktree` commands, replacing them with `/ads:undo` for in-place execution of sponsored proposals. The sponsored run now edits the working copy directly instead of using a git worktree, as indicated by the `SPONSORED_IN_PLACE_VERSION` constant and the new `SponsoredSend` type in `cli/src/types/contracts/send-message.ts`. The proposal card UI moved from the transcript into the dock above the composer, and the target resolution now prioritizes the opaque workspace ID from `.freebuff/project-id` over the `owner/repo` remote name.
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.evidence: Version bump in freebuff/cli/release/package.json and in-place sponsored proposal flow in cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts
3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.unknowns: The diff does not show whether the `/ads:pull-request` command removal breaks external scripts or documentation that reference it. A second read of the same diff did not confirm that a migration step is required.

3dd05d3b673ee4d6db441f3ff75480154b3d4a1f.text: The Freebuff CLI now runs sponsored tasks directly in your current project folder instead of creating a separate, isolated copy. When you approve one of these ad-funded tasks, the AI makes its changes to your actual files, and a new undo command lets you reverse those changes later. The task appears in the side panel rather than the main chat history, keeping your conversation clear while the ad-funded work streams in. The system now identifies your project by a unique folder ID, ensuring tasks are tied to your specific checkout even if you do not have a remote repository. Security checks now treat local environment configuration files as sensitive credentials, preventing sponsored tasks from reading them.

5f5be8125dc4c7507742022f3c12b60db0471670.text: Freebuff now lets you keep a paid session running while the app checks for updates in the background, so your work is not interrupted by a forced restart. The update is installed silently when you finish your session, and you see a simple message that the new version is ready for your next launch. A new read-only view lets you browse saved chat history without re-entering a live session, with specific keys to open history or choose a new model. The app now supports multiple concurrent sessions per account, so you can run separate tasks in different terminals without one replacing the other. If a session is taken over by another device, the app clearly explains this happened and offers to restart it rather than locking you out. These changes make it safer to update the app and more flexible to manage multiple coding tasks at once.

a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.title: Add /reasoning command to select model effort
a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.summary: A new Freebuff-only /reasoning slash command (aliases: effort, think) opens the model picker directly on the reasoning submenu for the selected model. The command reads the current model from freebuffChatModel, checks the model directory for adjustable reasoning efforts, and either displays a system message suggesting /model if no efforts exist or opens the reasoning picker via openFreebuffReasoningPicker. The picker now accepts an initialView property that initializes the reasoning submenu state with the model's saved effort, allowing users to adjust reasoning level without re-selecting the model.
a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.evidence: The diff adds a reasoning command with aliases effort and think to cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts, introduces openFreebuffReasoningPicker in cli/src/state/freebuff-chat-store.ts, and updates cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx to support an initialView of reasoning that renders a submenu for selecting reasoning effort.

6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.title: Freebuff CLI 0.0.196 removes session pacing and adds DeepSeek filter
6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.summary: This release removes the free-mode session pacing notice mechanism, deleting the `freebuff-session-slowed` module and its SDK listener in favor of a simpler session-length model. It adds shared error constants for DeepSeek's content filter, instructing users to retry with another model since the entire conversation is re-sent on retry. The CLI now recognizes a launcher update restart via a new `isLauncherUpdateTermination` helper, keeping the held free session slot so the relaunched binary can resume it instead of dropping the user back to the model picker. The `report_project_profile` tool is reclassified as an `agent_control` capability, and a new agentic pool wire contract defines the `Desktop-Agentic` placement identifier.
6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.evidence: Member 4dd7beb1 deletes `common/src/util/freebuff-session-slowed.ts` and removes `setFreeModeSessionSlowedListener` from `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts` and `sdk/src/index.ts`. Member 29e85c6f adds `FREEBUFF_PROVIDER_CONTENT_FILTER_ERROR_PATTERN` and `FREEBUFF_PROVIDER_CONTENT_FILTER_MESSAGE` to `common/src/constants/freebuff-errors.ts`. Member 3d5300b6 adds `keepSlotForRelaunch` to `cli/src/state/freebuff-session-store.ts` and `isLauncherUpdateTermination` to `cli/src/utils/launcher-update-restart.ts`.
6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.unknowns: The specific consumer of the new agentic pool constants and the rollout status of the in-place sponsored execution contract are not shown in this release's diff.

a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.title: /todo command opens a live checklist panel in the CLI
a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.summary: A new /todo slash command (with alias /todos) opens a read-only panel above the composer that displays the latest checklist emitted by the main agent via the `write_todos` tool. The panel, defined in `cli/src/components/todo-panel.tsx`, scrolls independently, shows completion counts, and yields the keyboard back to the composer on Escape or when another interactive panel (review, question, or sponsored proposal menu) takes priority. The `getLatestTodos` function in `cli/src/utils/todos.ts` resolves the most recent valid list from root-level tool blocks, ensuring subagent checklists never overwrite the main agent's progress and that explicit empty lists clear previous state.
a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.evidence: cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts adds a new defineCommand entry for 'todo' that returns { openTodoPanel: true }, and cli/src/chat.tsx renders the new TodoPanel component when that flag is set, sourcing items from getLatestTodos in cli/src/utils/todos.ts.

7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.title: Space Bunny Alpha loses Recommended badge in picker
7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.summary: The `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` model is no longer badged as Recommended in the free model picker. The diff removes the recommended flag from its placement in `common/src/util/freebuff-picker-sections.ts` and adds a comment noting that OpenRouter withdrew the model on 2026-10-05, moving it to OpenCode Zen's free lane. This is one of two model placement updates in the shared picker utility, the other being the move of Solar Pro 4 to the Unlimited section.
7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.evidence: The diff in `common/src/util/freebuff-picker-sections.ts` removes the recommended property from the `stealth/space-bunny-alpha` placement object and adds a comment explaining that OpenRouter withdrew the model on 2026-10-05.

changes.what: Removed the Recommended badge from Space Bunny Alpha in the model picker placement configuration.
Updated model placement comments and structure for Solar Pro 4 and other models in the picker utility.

547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.title: Freebuff CLI moves model selection to /model and adds send-time
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.summary: This commit removes the `/reasoning` slash command and introduces `/model` to open the in-chat model picker, replacing the previous landing-screen-only selection flow. The new `FreebuffChatControls` and `useFreebuffChatAdmission` hook defer session admission to the moment a user sends their first message, allowing model switches and wallet consent without terminating the active session. Several supporting changes include a new `FreebuffChatFooter` displaying the current model, a rewritten `HelpBanner` with keyboard shortcut groups, and `AI_SDK_LOG_WARNINGS` redirection to keep SDK diagnostics off the terminal.
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.evidence: cli/src/commands/command-registry.ts adds `/model` to FREEBUFF_ONLY_COMMANDS and removes `/reasoning`, while cli/src/state/freebuff-chat-store.ts and cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-chat-admission.ts implement the new chat-admission flow that gates message sending on model selection and wallet consent.
547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.unknowns: The diff does not explicitly state why the reasoning command was consolidated into the model picker rather than kept as a standalone command.

changes.what: Replaces the `/reasoning` command with a `/model` command that opens the model picker in-chat and defers session admission to send-time.
Adds new Freebuff-specific chat UI components including a header with session metadata, a footer with model status, and updated status bar styling for the Freebuff variant.
Rewrites the HelpBanner to display grouped keyboard shortcuts and adds `?` and `←` keybindings for empty input to trigger help and history.
Redirects AI SDK warnings to the internal logger to prevent them from overwriting the terminal UI and extracts the Freebuff wordmark into a dedicated utility.

a61f607636af6e402f47c6e80dd0a901f446a822.text: A new shortcut command lets you adjust how deeply the AI thinks before answering, without changing which model you are using. This feature is available only to people using the free version of the assistant in their terminal. If your current model does not support adjustable thinking levels, the command will simply tell you to pick a different model instead.

a4846ebf48b5d8bbe08744fb2d6f26f119d19861.text: A new /todo command in the terminal app opens a live panel that shows the AI assistant's current task checklist, including how many items are finished. The panel stays open and updates in real time as the assistant works, and closes when you press the escape key or when a more important screen, like a question from the assistant, takes over. This helps you watch the assistant's progress without scrolling through the conversation history.

6cb48cab1ae6c608e7617ee804c8a6f3ea52ce9f.text: This release updates the Freebuff coding assistant to improve how it handles paid sessions and manages sponsored tasks. When the app automatically updates itself, it now keeps your paid session active so you do not have to pay again or choose a model all over. A newer AI model called GPT-6 Luna is now used for certain thinking tasks, replacing an older version that is no longer available in the free list. For sponsored ad tasks, you can now choose to run them directly in your project files instead of creating a separate branch, with clear options to review or undo the changes. The app also includes a new safety check that stops sponsored tasks from accidentally changing your version control history, and adds a clear warning if a specific AI provider rejects your request due to its own content rules.

547e2f0af84c148d1eb8107513f9ba88fe3589d7.text: Choosing which AI model to use now happens while you are chatting, not just when you first open the app. The old command for adjusting how hard the model thinks has been removed; that setting now lives inside the new model-choice screen, so you pick the model and its thinking depth in one place. This affects you every time you use the free coding assistant in your terminal: if you cancel a model switch or change your mind before sending a message, your chat stays exactly where it was, and a new line at the bottom of the screen shows which model is currently active and how to change it.

7df0b7d4139f73d59ac96a455a0960c2c52566c8.text: The free AI model called Space Bunny Alpha no longer displays a Recommended label next to its name in the model picker. This happened on October 5, 2026, after the service that supplied the model stopped offering it and the model moved to a different free listing. If you use the Freebuff tool, you will no longer see the recommendation badge on that specific model, but the model remains available in the unlimited section without the extra highlight.

3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.title: CLI renderer fallback and temp dir cleanup
3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.summary: The CLI now loads the OpenTUI native renderer via `ensureRenderLibrary`, which falls back to a content-addressed copy in the config directory if the temp directory copy is unavailable (full, read-only, or noexec). If that also fails, `describeRenderLibraryFailure` produces an actionable message explaining the temp directory issue instead of crashing with a raw OpenTUI error. After a successful start, `sweepLeakedRenderLibraryCopies` runs in the background to remove stale byte-identical copies Bun leaves in the temp directory, capping the sweep at 200 files and skipping copies younger than 10 minutes. The `BUN_TMPDIR` environment variable is now read to locate Bun's extraction directory.
3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.evidence: New module `cli/src/utils/opentui-native-library.ts` defines `ensureRenderLibrary` (which falls back to a content-addressed install in the config dir when `resolveRenderLib` fails) and `sweepLeakedRenderLibraryCopies` (which deletes stale `.<16 hex>-<8 hex>.<ext>` files older than `STALE_COPY_AGE_MS`), both wired into `cli/src/index.tsx` before renderer creation.

b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.title: Improve terminal broker error handling for empty and truncated
b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.summary: The terminal command broker in `cli/src/utils/terminal-command-broker.ts` now handles empty or truncated protocol result files by returning a descriptive error message instead of surfacing raw `JSON.parse` errors. A new `probeTempDirectory` function checks if the temp directory is writable and provides specific recovery guidance (freeing space or setting `TMPDIR`) when the result file cannot be written due to disk full or permission issues. The `writeProtocolResponse` function is now exported and removes partial files on write failure, while `parseProtocol` guards against empty input before attempting JSON parsing.
b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.evidence: The diff modifies `cli/src/utils/terminal-command-broker.ts` to add `probeTempDirectory` and `writeProtocolResponse`, and updates `parseProtocol` to use `INCOMPLETE_RESPONSE_MESSAGE` instead of raw JSON parse errors.

b1813969c4abf069b5c793cf86bdd0303d76234a.text: The terminal assistant now gives clear, actionable error messages when command results fail to save due to a full or inaccessible temporary folder, instead of showing confusing system errors or telling you to restart the app. This affects anyone using the Freebuff command-line tool in their terminal. You will notice more helpful instructions on how to fix storage issues, allowing you to continue working without needing to quit and reopen the application.

3aecc760b7f2eb5b3f737c9b534697cd05b317a0.text: When the Freebuff terminal program cannot start because the computer's temporary storage is full, read-only, or blocked from running software, it now saves a backup copy of its screen engine to its own private folder instead of crashing. If that backup also fails, the program shows clear instructions on how to fix the temporary storage problem instead of a confusing technical error. After a successful start, the program quietly removes old, unnecessary copies of the screen engine that the launcher left behind, keeping your temporary storage from filling up over time. You will only notice this change if the terminal used to fail to open on your machine; otherwise, nothing looks different.

0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.title: MiMo agent definitions add human-readable model label
0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.summary: The `createBase2` and `createBase3CliRoot` agent factories now accept an optional `modelLabel` parameter that overrides the wire ID shown in the system prompt. The `base2-free-mimo` and `base3-free-mimo` agent definitions pass the current `displayName` from `getFreebuffModel(FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID)` as this label. This addresses the mismatch where the `FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID` wire ID implies version 2.5, but the served model is actually MiMo 2.6 Flash, as noted in the `freebuff-models.ts` comments.
0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.evidence: In `agents/base2/base2.ts`, the `createBase2` function signature adds a `modelLabel?: string` option with the comment 'Human model name for the prompt when the wire id is a legacy alias.', and both `agents/base2/base2-free-mimo.ts` and `agents/base3-free-mimo.ts` now import `getFreebuffModel` to pass `modelLabel: getFreebuffModel(FREEBUFF_MIMO_V25_MODEL_ID).displayName`.
0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.unknowns: The diff does not show which specific prompt template string inside `createBase2` or `createBase3CliRoot` is updated to consume the new `modelLabel` parameter.

f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.title: SDK final refusals now cover session superseded
f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.summary: The SDK model provider now treats a 409 response with the `session_superseded` error code as a final, non-retryable refusal, joining the existing `turn_spend_limit` 429. This prevents the AI SDK from retrying these intentional server responses four times with backoff, which previously added roughly 14 seconds of delay before the user saw the error card. The `throwIfFinalRefusal` function checks the response body for a matching status and error code combination before throwing a non-retryable `APICallError`.
f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.evidence: The diff in `sdk/src/impl/model-provider.ts` replaces the single-purpose `throwIfTurnSpendCapped` function with a `FINAL_REFUSALS` array and a generalized `throwIfFinalRefusal` handler that covers both the `turn_spend_limit` 429 and the `session_superseded` 409 status code. `sdk/src/impl/stream-interruption.ts` updates its doc comment to reference this new mechanism.
f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.unknowns: The diff does not specify the exact user-facing text change when a session is superseded, only that the server's message is preserved.

0f35bd7aa3a4739f2c8c36d17aa8f3937eeb16ca.text: The internal instructions given to the AI assistant now include the current, human-readable name of the specific MiMo model being used, rather than relying on an outdated technical identifier that implies an older version. This is an internal update to the agent definitions and does not change which models are available to you or how the assistant behaves during your coding sessions. No new features, model access, or user-facing benefits are introduced by this change.

f16c22ffd26f219ed99d694bce4fff84efeb4751.text: When the assistant receives a definite server response that a session has ended or been replaced, it now stops immediately instead of automatically retrying the request several times. This affects developers who use the Freebuff tool, including those building with the developer kit. You will see the error message telling you to start a new session right away, saving about 14 seconds of unnecessary waiting.

7484523d06e69a5ad4ff37292edce02389ce71bf.title: Add bundled agents schema validation tests
7484523d06e69a5ad4ff37292edce02389ce71bf.summary: A new test suite verifies that all agent definitions shipped in the CLI bundle pass the local `DynamicAgentTemplateSchema` validation. It asserts that every `spawnableAgents` ID referenced by a bundled agent resolves to another bundled agent or built-in template type, preventing unqualified IDs that fail server-side validation. The suite also confirms that the registry correctly merges project-specific custom agents and `mcp.json` configurations with the base bundle without producing validation errors.

1a2b5e9ba875ca41db6cdce6ca13fb93796527b0.summary: A new utility `uuidv7` is added to `common/src/util/uuidv7.ts` to generate RFC 9562 version-7 UUIDs, encoding the current Unix time in milliseconds in the first 48 bits followed by 74 random bits. The implementation uses division instead of bit shifts to handle the 48-bit timestamp, because JavaScript bit shifts truncate to 32 bits. The generated IDs are time-ordered strings that maintain compatibility with existing PostgreSQL `uuid` columns and Zod `.uuid()` validators, which accept UUID versions 1 through 8. This supports primary keys for append-heavy tables like `agent_run`, where chronological ordering improves B-tree page locality compared to random version-4 IDs.

6931512368f9e246683b095dd2bf8ff43a811af8.title: BYOK metadata store lock recovery for crashed writers
6931512368f9e246683b095dd2bf8ff43a811af8.summary: The `withLock` implementation in the BYOK metadata store now publishes the process ID atomically via a candidate file and `fs.link`, replacing the previous two-step `fs.open` and write that left unrecoverable locks if a process was killed between operations. A new `recoverByokLock` function in `sdk/src/impl/byok-lock.ts` checks whether the lock owner PID is dead and unlinks the stale lock if so, using a loopback TCP server keyed by the PID to prevent concurrent reaper races. This allows the SDK to automatically clear stale `connections.lock` files instead of requiring the user to manually delete the file after a crash.

The new `sdk/src/impl/byok-lock.ts` module exports `recoverByokLock`, which checks if the PID owner is dead via `process.kill(pid, 0)` and uses a loopback TCP server as a re-entrancy guard before unlinking the lock file.

f6c9bf23ecd733d05db82bdabd99521388488a73.summary: The `freebucksTimeZoneHeaders` function in `common/src/util/freebucks-timezone.ts` now omits the `x-fb-timezone` header instead of sending it when the runtime resolves an unreliable or unknown timezone. This change prevents the server from shifting a user's Freebucks reset schedule to a wrong day, which would cost them a daily refill. A new `freebucksDeviceTimeZone` function evaluates the environment to detect cases where the zone should be suppressed, including when running on a remote host (SSH, Codespaces, dev containers) or when the OS reports a fixed-offset zone on Windows. 8ea9ab3e1f7758075f6ed807a54065e1ba89894a.text: Internal engineers created a single, consistent label for each chat record to prevent the system from accidentally discarding data when two different users happen to have the same message ID. To make this work, the team also added several optional fields to the stored records that internal tools can use to sort and search through conversation history. This is a maintenance update that does not change how the assistant works for you or affect your account, and it does not require any action on your part.

6931512368f9e246683b095dd2bf8ff43a811af8.text: The tool now automatically clears leftover safety files when a previous attempt to change your saved settings crashed, instead of requiring you to delete them by hand. This affects people who save their own keys or endpoints so the assistant can use them directly, protecting your saved list of connections. You will no longer hit a wall that says your settings are locked after a crash; the next time you edit or delete a saved connection, the stale lock clears itself.

4e4d4fba46003ba207febba03a65bb1ac4286c48.text: Freebuff operators can now record which ad database held your personal ad settings when the system finishes fetching ads. This is an internal logging update that helps the service team track infrastructure details without exposing private ad or advertiser information. You will not see any changes in the app, and no action is needed.

f6c9bf23ecd733d05db82bdabd99521388488a73.text: The application now carefully checks whether it can confidently determine your actual local time before sharing that information with the service. If it is running on a remote computer, inside a container, or if the operating system reports a generic or unreliable time zone, the application leaves out the time detail entirely instead of guessing or defaulting to a standard offset. This protects your free account from having its daily credit refill schedule accidentally shifted to the wrong day, which would prevent you from receiving your expected daily refresh. You do not need to change any settings; the application simply avoids sending incorrect time data that could disrupt your usual free credit cycle.

97f87bffa6fd5398dc1751ffc1aa8788416d257b.text: The team set up a new way to test which ads show to you by using pre-calculated scores instead of random rotation. Half of you will be assigned to the new scoring method and half to the old random method, but this split only activates once a specific data file is published; until then, the system behaves exactly as it does today. No one sees a difference in daily use because the feature is currently dormant and the change is part of the internal ad-serving infrastructure.

1e49cb763a73d9381f5724a9f34264c0a7fb95df.title: SDK agent trust gate now covers MCP servers and validates registry IDs
1e49cb763a73d9381f5724a9f34264c0a7fb95df.summary: The SDK's remote agent trust gate in `sdk/src/agent-publisher-trust.ts` now refuses templates that declare `mcpServers` in addition to `handleSteps`, recognizing that MCP server definitions are executable content that can spawn local commands or send environment variables to external URLs. This prevents an attacker from crafting a malicious agent ID like `codebuff/x@..\..\evil\payload\latest` to bypass the trust gate by redirecting the fetch to a different publisher's namespace. The error message in `UntrustedAgentPublisherError` is updated to mention MCP servers explicitly.

c838c9d5a1601b11eefa74984610ab6ab49980e7.summary: The streak bonus status line now interprets `nextResetAt` as the account's own daily reset instant rather than a fixed Pacific midnight, aligning with the 2026-10-01 shift where streak days are counted on the account's daily allowance interval. A new `nextResetAt` field was added to the `FreebuffUsageStreakSummary` interface in `common/src/types/freebuff-usage.ts` to expose this account-specific reset time to the account hub UI. This ensures that developers reading the CLI or Desktop app see the bonus expiration time in their own local timezone, resolving confusion for users east of Pacific.

45917a419db7942c34b29fba5a262d91842edfa7.title: Context-pruner run skip now matches agent name not substring
45917a419db7942c34b29fba5a262d91842edfa7.summary: The agent runtime in `packages/agent-runtime/` now identifies the context-pruner agent for run-tracking skips by exact agent name instead of a substring match. Previously, `agentTemplate.id.includes('context-pruner')` caught any model-calling agent whose id merely contained that name (for example 'context-pruner-test-agent'), minted it an untracked run id, and caused its first LLM call to fail with 'runId Not Found' because the web API refuses untracked ids. The fix calls `parseAgentId` and compares its `agentId` to 'context-pruner', so only the bundled and publisher-qualified pruner ids ('context-pruner', 'codebuff/context-pruner@1.0.0') get the no-op ledger stubs, while every other agent keeps its ledger run. No other files or subsystems are touched.
45917a419db7942c34b29fba5a262d91842edfa7.evidence: The diff in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` changes the context-pruner run-tracking skip from `agentTemplate.id.includes('context-pruner')` to `parseAgentId(agentTemplate.id).agentId === 'context-pruner'`, and adds a test asserting that 'context-pruner-test-agent' retains its ledger run while 'context-pruner' and 'codebuff/context-pruner@1.0.0' skip it.

changes.what: The context-pruner skip in `loopAgentSteps` now matches the parsed agent name exactly rather than a substring, preventing false positives that broke model-calling agents with 'context-pruner' embedded in their id.

737f5fdd98e579cadfc0e785f8e13946bf9d97f7.summary: A new `FREEBUFF_RETIRED_MODEL_IDS` list in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` marks MiniMax M3, GLM 5.2, and Ox Alpha as fully retired, with `freebuffRetiredModelMessage` instructing clients to update their Freebuff binary because the models are no longer served on Freebuff agents. 1e49cb763a73d9381f5724a9f34264c0a7fb95df.text: The assistant now blocks downloadable tools that try to run commands or send your private data to outside websites if they come from creators you have not marked as trusted. It also refuses to fetch tool packages that are named with tricks meant to hide where they actually come from. This protects your computer and personal information when you ask the assistant to use add-ons from the public directory. You do not need to take any action, but you will see a clear warning if an add-on is blocked until you trust its creator.

45917a419db7942c34b29fba5a262d91842edfa7.text: The assistant’s bookkeeping now recognizes the helper that trims conversation history by its full, exact name instead of any name that just contains the word 'pruner'. This internal fix ensures that other tools with similar names are no longer mistaken for that specific helper, which previously caused them to fail when they first tried to use an AI model. This is a maintenance change to the core engine; you will not see any new features, settings, or visible changes in the application.

c838c9d5a1601b11eefa74984610ab6ab49980e7.text: The daily streak bonus message now shows when the day ends in your own local time zone instead of a fixed Pacific time. This affects you if you have been building a seven-day streak for extra free credits and live outside the Pacific time zone. The status line will say "midnight" when the day resets at your local midnight, or it will name the specific day of the week if the reset falls further out, so you know exactly when your next bonus arrives.

737f5fdd98e579cadfc0e785f8e13946bf9d97f7.text: Three older AI models (MiniMax M3, GLM 5.2, and Ox Alpha) are now fully retired from the free AI coding assistant, meaning the system stops serving them to anyone. At the same time, Space Bunny Alpha is now officially available to users in limited-access regions, fixing a report that the model had disappeared from their choices. If you are using an older version of the CLI or desktop app that still tries to reach one of the retired models, you will see a message telling you to update your app to the latest version. The three English and Chinese documentation pages and the CLI release notes were updated to reflect these catalog changes.

d39b73d5da6478aaa896070eedb17835d6d9c282.text: The coding assistant can now find a program called Git on Windows even if it was not added to the system's standard list of paths, by checking common installation folders and a specific version bundled inside a popular repository tool. This is for anyone using the assistant on Windows who relies on version control to save their work. You may notice the assistant successfully running version control commands that previously failed with a missing tool error, requiring no new setup from you.

fd8544efc05980f125eeb774c42bc4a5bc7c1bd0.text: Two new large-format image spaces are reserved on the desktop app, one on the side menu and one in the right-hand panel, along with clear size guides for the pictures that will fill them. This is an internal update for the advertising team that sells these spaces, so there is no change in how you use the app today. These reserved spaces do not yet have any ads in them, so you will not notice anything new in your daily routine.

3f2d082375aabc8445a2cf61d9a107d8c895e905.text: The advertising tracking codes used to measure advertiser campaigns on X were rotated to new identifiers. This is an internal infrastructure update for the people who run the Freebuff service, not a change that affects advertisers or end-users. You will not notice any difference in your daily use of the coding assistant, and no action is needed on your part.

5a7029d37117e9437e43a5260de124977ec3ee66.text: The brief that the service sends to the app to display a paid plan offer to users in restricted regions now includes only a single main line of text, dropping the second supporting line. This internal update simplifies the data format so that the upgrade message appears as one concise sentence rather than two. No users are affected by this change, and it does not alter the pricing, benefits, or availability of any plan.

f9d8ab812096fdcfcf2e35cee46dff6ce2ce18ee.text: A temporary warning badge that marked a special discount on a deep-thinking AI model as "ending soon" has been removed. This affects developers who use the free coding assistant, specifically those who selected this model in their model picker. You will no longer see the "Ending soon" label next to this model; instead, the model now displays with its new standard pricing, and no further action is required from you.
